chapters.title: Chapter 1: Forced Marriage
paragraphs: A woman who seemed like a saintess, wearing holy attire and possessing golden hair, stood in front of the Goddess of Light’s statue with a pious expression.
Behind her stood two female priests in the same holy attire.
"Begin the summoning."
The Saintess’s loud voice echoed throughout the hall. Then she kneeled in front of the statue, and all the priests available in the summoning hall followed her.
THUD.
Five people who radiated authority and power stood on a high platform, observing everything.
"What do you think? From which race will the hero come?"
said the red-haired woman with draconic eyes in a calm voice.
"Last time, a Dragon Race person came."
Another woman with green hair, brown eyes, and pointed ears said while giving the draconic woman a look. Then she added,
"So this time, someone else will come."
The other two women and one man standing beside them didn’t say anything and simply looked calmly at the summoning circle, which was now complete.
Then everyone in the hall heard the Saintess’s voice.
"Oh, Hero who will save the world from the demons and bring light to Valtharion."
Nothing happened for two seconds.
Then—

The Goddess’s statue started glowing with intense light as the summoning circle also began to shine. A pillar of white light erupted upward and instantly passed through the roof as it headed toward the heavens themselves.
Everyone inside the hall gave a knowing look, as this meant the hero summoning was almost complete, while the priests’ expressions became more fanatic.
Outside, the whole of Valtharion became active as everyone looked toward the pillar of light. Then they started kneeling while some bowed with respect and reverence for the Goddess’s power.
SWHOOSH

The pillar of white light suddenly disappeared, and the glowing summoning circle slowly became visible. Many people tried to look inside, but the light was still bright. Even the five rulers were unable to see inside.

After waiting for five minutes, the silhouette of a young man with black hair and blue eyes slowly became visible. He was sitting there wearing normal white pants and a shirt, with a confused expression.
"Huh? A human."
From the crowd, a voice echoed through the hall.
Everyone became surprised. Then the young man stood up and looked around in confusion. Seeing people staring at him as if he were something bizarre, he gathered his courage and asked,
"Where am I?"
Silence.
No one replied to him. Instead, they turned toward the only man present among the four women.
He also followed their gaze and noticed the five lavishly dressed people standing on a golden platform.
Then his eyes met the only man, who simply looked at him calmly.
Finally noticing the silence, the Saintess picked up a transparent crystal ball from a priest’s hands and started walking toward me.
"So beautiful."
That was the only thought that came into my mind as her blonde hair swayed gently and her eyes calmly looked at me.
After she stood in front of me, a bright smile appeared on her face.
"Young Hero, you have been summoned to Valtharion to save the world from the demons."
I became confused.
"Demons? Hero?"
I muttered, upon which she nodded and held the transparent ball toward me.
"Please touch this Awakening Crystal."
I first looked at her hand, which seemed as white as snow, before focusing my gaze on the crystal.
My hand reached toward it.
I hesitated for a moment as everyone present urged me with their eyes.
"Do it. It’s all about touching it."
That seemed to be what all their eyes were saying.
"Huff."
I took a deep breath and, with a final push, touched it.
"Cold."
The crystal felt cold to the touch.
I waited and looked around, but everyone remained silent as they were also waiting.
For a moment, nothing happened.
A minute later, still nothing.
The Human Emperor’s face slowly started changing as anxiety grew with each passing moment.
Even after five minutes, nothing happened.
The Saintess shook her head regretfully and said,
"The Young Hero does not have any talent."
Silence.
Then—
"HAHAHA!"
Laughter erupted from the red-haired woman, while the other empresses also tried to control their laughter.
The Human Emperor’s face became ugly, and he clenched his fists.
OHM!
Suddenly, a mysterious sound echoed throughout Valtharion.
The Saintess’s eyes turned white, filled with light, and an intense pressure descended upon everyone. Including the emperors and empresses, everyone kneeled before it.
Even I was forced face-first into the ground.
Then came an ancient, majestic voice.
"All five of you have to marry at least one of your children to him."
Their faces changed.
They hurriedly tried to ask for forgiveness, but the Goddess was already gone, leaving only the Saintess behind as her eyes slowly returned to normal.
With a sigh, all of them gave me a glaring look before exiting the place.
"What happened?"
I asked absentmindedly as I tried to get up.
Then a hand helped me.
"Thank you,"
I muttered unconsciously before looking toward the person.
The Saintess still had a smile on her face.
But when I heard her next words, my mind went blank for a second.
"Young Hero, we have to hurry. You have a marriage within one hour."
"Huh?"
I muttered in confusion.
Everything was going out of control.
First demons, then marriage?
But she didn’t give me more time to think.
Two male priests appeared behind me and dragged me toward the preparation room.
"Wait, who is my bride?"
I asked while being dragged.
The Saintess replied with a gentle smile,
"A princess."
After that, they took me to bathe and changed my clothes into a traditional white marriage gown.
"Huhu, you look good in this dress."
The two female priests combing my hair said while laughing.
My face turned red.
Finally, after thirty minutes, they took me to the marriage hall and left after giving their blessing.
"Young Hero, you are very lucky to marry a princess."
I sighed and started moving through the corridor while looking around.
"The whole place seems wealthy."
I touched the golden wall and thought.
Then I looked back toward the gate, where a few knights stood in shining holy armor.
"Can I run if I want?"
I thought.
CLANG.
When their swords touched the ground and a heavy sound echoed, I shook my head.
"No chance."
As I moved toward the ceremony hall, I heard a loud argument.
"Father, I was never meant to marry the Hero."
"Only the youngest son or daughter has always married the Hero."
I hid behind a pillar and peeked into the room through the slightly open door.
A very beautiful woman with raven-black hair and purple eyes spoke to the Human Emperor with an angry and desperate voice.
"Is it because I am of low birth and less talented than your youngest daughter?"
"That’s why you want me to marry a no-talent Hero?"
SLAP!
The Human Emperor slapped her.
A red handprint immediately appeared on her cheek.
"Ouch, that definitely will hurt."
I unconsciously touched my own cheek and muttered quietly.
Looking at her crying expression, I shook my head and started moving toward the ceremony hall.
"Poor girl."
After a few minutes, I finally reached the place.
I looked at the four holy knights guarding the door.
As I stepped forward, they opened it.
"Ah, thanks, I guess."
I said quietly.
They didn’t even look at me.
"Yeah, so much respect for a so-called Hero."
I muttered.
Though they seemed to hear it, they still didn’t react.
Inside, I saw a hall filled with people.
Every single one of them looked unbelievably rich.
Each of them is definitely wearing something made from gold.
I took one step, then another.
Slowly, I reached the front.
There stood the Saintess, still carrying the same smile.
This time, however, she held a holy book in her hands.
I nodded at her and stood beside her while waiting for my bride.
After waiting for several minutes while listening to the ridicule around me, I thought,
"Seems like they also heard what happened."
CREEEKKK
The main gate opened with a loud sound, attracting everyone’s attention.
I leaned slightly to look.
Then my breath stopped for a moment.
From the entrance came five beautiful women, each with distinctive features, wearing bridal gowns that covered their faces.
How did I know?
Because their figures seemed perfect, and their gait is elegant.
"Gulp."
I swallowed unconsciously.
A small chuckle came from beside me, but I ignored it.
As they stopped in front of me, the Saintess, who had remained quiet for some time, finally spoke.
"Young Hero, what is your name?"
I paused slightly as his eyes remained fixed on the brides.
"Luke Voidheart."
I answered after a moment.
The Saintess smiled, opened the book, and started reading from it.
Everyone listened calmly, while the priests listened with pious expressions.
The emperors and empresses watched with emotionless eyes.
Meanwhile, the other princes and princesses looked toward me with contempt, as though looking at a lowly lifeform.
I didn’t notice any of this.
My entire focus was on my soon-to-be wives.
Thinking about it made me smile happily.
The five brides could see through their veils.
After seeing his smile, their expressions became disgusted, and they clenched their fists.
Soon, a priest brought five holy cups filled with holy water and presented them to the brides.
All five paused for a moment before finally bringing the cups to their lips and drinking from them.
The priest then collected the cups and presented them to me.
Looking at the cups that still carried their lip marks, I smiled and drank every cup completely.
GULP.
Many men became jealous.
After all, the princesses they had dreamed of marrying would now become the wives of a talentless Hero.
After I finished the final cup, a blinding light descended from above.
I closed my eyes.
A few moments later, when I opened them again, I saw five chains of holy light descending from the heavens.
Each chain slowly moved toward a heart.
CLICK.
The clicking sound echoed throughout the hall.
Each chain connected one bride to me, while all five chains linked directly to my heart.
I slowly touched my heart and muttered while looking at my five wives.
"I am married."
"Marriage successful."
The Saintess’s voice echoed throughout the hall.
DING!
10,000 TIMES RETURN SYSTEM ACTIVATED!
[Chapter End]
I have had this story in my mind for quite some time, and now I am finally presenting it here. Please support me by adding this novel to your library.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Only Wife Who Came
paragraphs: After the marriage was done, I was brought to another house for rest.
"Please take care, young hero," the priest said before leaving.
Inside was a well-decorated room. Red flowers along with white ones were attached to the walls, and a beautiful chandelier could be seen above.
"So soft."
The bed’s blue fabric felt very soft, as I saw more than five pillows in place.
I laughed excitedly, thinking about tonight with my five princess wives.
"Hehe..."
But from afternoon to night came.
"Where the hell are they?"
I said angrily while drinking my seventh glass of milk that a maid had delivered. while looking toward the window. The sky was already pitch black, but they were not here.
My mood slumped as I fell back onto the bed.
"What do you expect, Luke? Why would anyone want to be with you?"
My vision blurred as tiny drops of moisture started collecting in my eyes, and I remembered things about my previous world.
DING!-
10,000x Return System Activated.
A ding sound suddenly echoed inside my head.
I got startled and then looked around.
"Nothing."
My expression turn to confusion "Is something invisible?"
"Who are you? Where are you?"
I asked intimidatedly toward the voice, though if anyone saw me, they would find my hands trembling and my eyes wary.
[Luke, I am your System.]
The System said with a cheerful voice while calling my name.
"Huh?"
I got confused, then after a moment I understood.
"Seems like transmigration stuff," I muttered.
Then my expression became excited.
"Will this System help me become strong?"
I laughed while saying that, then I thought about the Saintess saying something about hero stuff.
I shook my head and asked the System for its function.
"So, System, what can you do?"
I asked with an excited expression, hoping for something that would make me OP instantly.
[Luke, I am the 10,000x Return System.]
[So I can give you 10,000x returns from your wives.]
The System said normally.
"My wives?" I muttered, confused.
[Well... depending upon the emotions they have toward you, you will get a random return.]
"Oh... okay, I guess."
I said while rubbing my chin.
"Okay, show me status."
[STATUS]
Name: Luke Voidheart
Rank: None (Have not awakened)
Inventory: Empty
(Wives x 5)
I looked at my simple status, then my gaze turned toward Wives and I clicked on it.
Wife #1 — Human Princess
* Dependency: None
* Emotional State: Resentful
Wife #2 — Elf Princess
* Dependency: None
* Emotional State: Resentful
Wife #3 — Dragon Princess
* Dependency: None
* Emotional State: Resentful
Wife #4 — Mermaid Princess
* Dependency: None
* Emotional State: Resentful
Wife #5 — Vampire Princess
* Dependency: None
* Emotional State: Curious
"Well, what can I say?"
I said with a helpless sigh.
After all, they were forced to marry a talentless nobody like me.
But then my expression changed.
Wife #5 — Vampire Princess
Emotional State: Curious
When I looked at her status.
"She is curious?"
"About me?"
I muttered with a shocked expression, but then shook my head to remove those thoughts.
"No wonder no one came—"
CLICK!
As I was about to complete my words, the gate opened with a small click.
My gaze turned toward the silver door, and there was a woman with pink hair and red eyes, with a beauty unlike anything I had ever seen in my life.
Her face was perfect and pale like snow.
She was wearing a pink nightgown, which did little to hide her assets.
Those huge breasts and her figure were literally telling me to hold her.
"Gulp."
I swallowed after seeing this.
Wait!
Then my gaze reached toward her face again, and there was a smile on her lips, but there were also fangs, like those—
"Vampire!"
The word escaped my mouth before I could stop it.
Then I instantly covered my mouth with both hands, afraid she would become angry.
"Hehe."
Instead, she laughed and slowly walked toward me.
"Darling, did you miss me?"
She asked as she approached me closely and put her hand on my chest.
SHIVER
I got goosebumps when she touched me because she was cold as ice.
She noticed my expression, then her smile became wider and she got close to my ear.
"I am your wife, darling..."
"Are you afraid of me?"
She asked while making a crying face that looked like a puppy face, which almost melted my heart.
"No."
"I again blurted out instinctively."
"Haha."
She started laughing loudly, and my face got red from her teasing.
A moment passed before the question that had been bothering me finally slipped out.
"Don’t you resent me as well?"
Her expression changed slightly, and the laughter faded from her face.
"After all, you are a princess who can get anything."
As I said more and more, she started getting closer to me.
"Why are you here?"
The moment the words left my mouth, silence fell between us.
Maybe it was resentment toward everyone, as they brought me here and told everyone that I was a talentless nobody.
They forced me to marry, and now those wives who should understand that I am their husband are ignoring me.
And now she comes here, after all of that.
Selene Nightveil looked toward the person who was now her husband.
At the start, she also resented him because she was very talented and was now marrying a nobody.
She got treated worse in her household because they thought she killed her mother and had never shown love to her.
She knew she would eventually be thrown to some fat or perverted noble for benefits because even her father hated her.
But when she saw the person who was going to be her husband getting laughed at by everyone for being a talentless nobody—
He was still smiling while looking at us.
At that moment, the loneliness behind that smile became clear.
After all, a lifetime spent alone understands another lifetime spent alone.
That’s why tonight, I came here.
"Because you are my husband."
A genuine smile appeared on my face.
He flinched when he heard this, and his expression became flustered.
"How cute."
I laughed at his behavior and asked with a naughty smile.
"Darling, then should we do what a husband and wife do on their first night?"
"Huh?"
Luke said before he felt his vision go black.
[Chapter End]

🔹 FORM 3 — TITAN ASCENSION (EMERGENCY BERSERK)
Body enlargement (2-3x)
Strength ×5 burst (temporary)
Pressure aura intimidation
High stamina drain
"Crazy!" I said in an excited voice, because this was totally insane.
As I was feeling too happy, the System’s cursed voice came out again to pour water on my happiness.
[Luke]
"What?" I narrowed my eyes suspiciously, because I knew he was going to say something annoying again.
The System ignored Luke’s look and told him the words it had wanted to say after his excitement had reached its peak.
[Sadly, Luke, this isn’t an ability you can control.]
"What do you mean?" My expression darkened at those words, but I waited for the System to continue.
[This form consumes an enormous amount of stamina, Luke, and as a mortal, you simply don’t have enough to sustain it.]
"Okay." I nodded calmly, unfazed by his insult.
[So, you will become like a tired bull that has lost all sense of reason, and you will go berserk.]
[That’s why I added the tag Emergency Berserk.]
"So, I have to reach the Body Tempering Realm before I can use this properly without going berserk?"
[Yes.]
I nodded, though my mood had already shifted to something like, "Okay, we’ll deal with it when the time comes."
"What about the 2nd Form?
Can I summon the armor and weapon?"
I asked with a little bit of hope, but the System quickly crushed it.
[¬‿¬ Why don’t you give it a try yourself?]
I sighed.
It seems like that’s not going to work either.
After waiting sometime, Selene finally got out from the bath.
Then we dressed before coming out and going toward the temple to get final blessing.
The palace corridors were wide and silent again, servants bowing slightly as we passed.
During traveling Selene told me about the previous hero, which was a dragonkin girl and how she defeated the enemy.
While talking, we finally reached the temple.
Even from outside, the structure was massive—white stone pillars glowing faintly under divine runes, and a pressure of holy energy pressing gently on the skin.
I looked around to observe and found that this temple is bigger than the previous one from which they summoned me.
After we stepped in, I noticed there were many people of all races, talking and laughing while each making group with their own races people.
Humans, elves, beastkin, vampires—each corner had its own quiet dominance, like invisible borders drawn in the air.
The moment we entered, many eyes turned towards us and started muttering something.
A few voices slipped through.
"...That’s the Hero?"
"...The talentless one?"
"...And those are his wives?"
I ignored their talks and then Selene voice come.
"Seems like we are late," Selene said in a low voice as she leaned close to me.
"And whose fault is this?"
My expression darkened when I remembered, as she was hell bent on sucking me dry.
After hearing my word, she laughed in a small voice.
Then—
A Vampire man with long silver hair and black eyes came in front of Selene and knelt.
The entire hall gradually quieted.
Even the background chatter faded as attention shifted.
Everyone stopped what they were doing and looked toward the entrance where we were standing.
Luke’s four wives also turned toward them.
Selene narrowed her eyes, then turned toward the group of other vampire men and women standing in the corner beside a handsome long black hair and red-eyed vampire, who was smiling.
"What’s that fucker wants to do?"
Selene felt a bad premonition in her heart as she thought about this.
The kneeling man straightened his posture slightly, clearly gathering courage under dozens of gazes.
"Miss Selene, I have admired you and your beauty for a very long time."
He said with a smile on his face.
"I always thought I am not worthy enough, but now I feel I am."
A few nobles whispered immediately.
"...He actually said it."
"...In front of the Hero too..."
Selene already knew where this is going, because she had seen this type of thing many times.
"Miss Selene, will you marry me?"
The moment his final words left—
Silence.
An absolute silence.
Even the candle flames seemed to flicker softer for a moment.
Because no one dares to disrespect a princess before, and now this person is clearly asking for the hand of a princess who just married a hero.
Everyone started gossiping.
"Will he take the bait?"
The black-haired vampire said in a low voice.
Luke’s wives also narrowed their eyes and looked toward Selene and Luke, watching how they would handle this.
As everyone was thinking that he would chicken out, but he did something unexpected.
"I challenge you to a duel of honor."
Luke’s angry voice echoed throughout the temple.
A few gasps immediately followed.
"...He’s insane."
"...A duel already?"
"...Against a vampire noble?"
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Titan Knight Awakening
paragraphs: As we entered, a silver-haired vampire came in front of Selene and knelt.
"What the hell is he doing?" I thought irritably, but I didn’t stop him.
The moment he knelt, the noisy temple hall quieted slightly.
Several nobles turned their heads curiously while wine glasses paused midway through the air.
When he said his next words, I could hear the mockery and quiet laughter spreading through the hall.
But his last words snapped something inside me and before I even realized it—
"I challenge you to a duel of honor!"
My angry voice echoed throughout the temple.
The entire hall froze.
Even the musicians in the corner stopped playing.
I know it can be a trap or something, but I don’t care.
I only looked at him with rage boiling in my eyes, on which I could see he was smiling.
"Luke."
I heard Selene’s worried voice.
Which made me calm down a little, but my eyes never left him as I said only one thing to her.
"Trust me."
Her expression changed as she had not expected this from me, but she nodded with a small smile and added—
"If something happens to you, I will come in between—"
But before she could finish her sentence—
STEP.
STEP.
The black-haired and red-eyed vampire standing in the corner suddenly walked forward.
A heavy pressure spread faintly from his body as he smiled toward everyone.
"If it’s the Hero and my sister’s honor, then shouldn’t we make it a death duel?"
"After all..."
"He tried to provoke something he shouldn’t."
He finished with a smile while first looking at everyone, then toward us.
Everyone who heard his words had their expressions changed as they understood immediately—
He was trying to kill Luke.
Selene and the other four wives’ expressions became ugly because my life was connected to them.
The kneeling vampire also became visibly flustered because he never intended to kill Luke, or else he would lose Selene as well.
But then—
A majestic voice echoed alongside four terrifying presences.
"No need."
The red-haired woman with draconic eyes spoke calmly while another woman with black hair and crimson eyes gave the black-haired vampire a death glare.
The pressure in the hall instantly became suffocating.
Several younger nobles lowered their heads immediately.
Then the Human Emperor spoke while looking at the silver-haired vampire.
"If you agree to the Hero’s duel, then we can start."
Everyone smiled.
After all, they were finally going to see a hot-blooded Hero getting beaten for the first time in history.
The Saintess, who had been watching from the side silently, also became worried because this would tarnish the temple’s reputation as well.
But—
"Fine."
The silver-haired vampire answered with a mocking smile while looking toward me like prey.
Soon everyone started moving toward the training grounds behind the temple.
The path outside was massive, lined with giant white pillars and statues of previous heroes.
Cold wind swept across the open stone bridges connecting different sections of the temple.
As we walked, more and more people followed behind us.
News spread quickly.
"The Hero challenged a vampire noble!"
"No way—"
"He’s dead."
Excited whispers echoed everywhere.
Soon we finally reached the training grounds.
The arena was enormous—circular and built entirely from black stone.
Countless cracks and sword marks covered the walls from previous battles.
Several knight trainees and mages stopped their practice immediately after seeing the crowd gathering.
Even instructors climbed higher platforms to watch.
"This is going to be interesting."
As both of us stood opposite each other, he introduced himself first in an arrogant tone.
"I am Lucien Bloodgrave from House Bloodgrave."
"Luke Voidheart."
I answered calmly.
His expression instantly twisted with disgust as if hearing a commoner speak offended him.
A referee stepped between us and gave us one final look.
Then—
"START!"
The referee’s voice thundered throughout the arena.
A cold silence spread instantly.
Lucien smirked confidently while looking at me like prey already caught in his hands.
But I ignored him completely.
Instead—
I closed my eyes for a brief second.
*Tudum.*
Something pulsed deep inside my body.
Then—
DINNGG!
[SSS Rank Origin Skill — TITAN KNIGHT Activated]
A deep metallic sound echoed inside my mind.
Suddenly—
THOOOM!
A violent pressure exploded from inside my chest.
My heart started beating heavily.
*Tudum!*
*Tudum!*
*Tudum!*
Golden energy surged through my veins like molten metal.
I gritted my teeth.
"GHH—!"
Cracks spread beneath my feet.
*KRRRKKK—*
The black stone arena started splitting apart.
Thin golden lines slowly appeared across my arms like glowing runes.
The air around me trembled violently.
HUMMMMMM—
Dust slowly rose from the ground around my body.
My muscles tightened instantly.
Strength flooded every part of me.
Even my breathing became heavier.
The pain was intense—
Like something ancient and massive was waking up inside me.
Then finally—
BOOOOOOM!
A burst of golden aura exploded outward.
A shockwave spread across the arena.
WHOOSHHH!
Several nearby spectators stumbled backward, their robes fluttering wildly.
Even Lucien’s silver hair moved from the pressure.
My black hair lifted slightly upward as golden particles floated around me.
The entire arena fell silent. Everyone’s expressions changed.
Lucien’s confident smile froze slightly.
The system voice echoed calmly inside my head.
🔹 FORM 1 — BASE TITAN CORE Activated.
✔ Strength Increased ×1
✔ Durability Increased
✔ Regeneration Activated
I slowly opened my eyes.
Golden light flickered faintly within them.
Then I looked directly at Lucien.
"...Let’s continue."
BOOOOM!
The ground beneath me exploded.
Stone shattered everywhere as I rushed toward him like a cannonball.
Lucien’s eyes widened slightly.
Too fast.
BANG!!!
My fist slammed directly into his ribs.
A visible shockwave exploded outward.
CRAAACK!
The arena floor beneath him shattered instantly.
Lucien’s body blasted backward violently.
CRASHHHH!
He smashed through a stone pillar near the edge of the arena.
Dust exploded everywhere.
But I didn’t stop.
BOOM!
I kicked the ground again and charged forward.
The arena cracked beneath every step.
Before Lucien could recover—
BAM!
Another punch.
BANG!!
Another.
BOOOOM!!
Another.
Each hit shook the arena.
Stone debris flew everywhere.
The wall behind Lucien started cracking from repeated impacts.
Blood splattered from his mouth.
The spectators’ expressions slowly turned stunned.
Because this wasn’t supposed to happen.
"This... this is the talentless Hero?"
"No way..."
"How is he overpowering a vampire noble physically?!"
The emperors and empresses watched calmly.
After all, previous Heroes also possessed special gifts after summoning.
Selene finally relaxed slightly while looking at Luke.
A small proud smile appeared on her lips.
Meanwhile, the Dragon Princess narrowed her golden eyes slightly.
"...Interesting."
BAMMMM!
With one final punch, Lucien crashed hard into the arena floor.
The entire ground trembled.
A small crater formed beneath him.
I stopped moving and looked down.
His face was bloodied, and his breathing was rough.
But then—
A dangerous feeling suddenly crawled across my spine.
My instincts screamed.
But Before I could react—
BOOOOOOM!!!
A crimson explosion erupted instantly.
The next second.
BANG!!
My vision blurred as something smashed directly into my stomach.
CRAAASHHHH!!!
Luke body blasted across the arena.
Luke destroyed two stone pillars before crashing into the wall.
Dust and debris exploded everywhere.
Silence.
Then—
The spectators’ expressions returned to normal.
As if reality had corrected itself.
"How can a talentless Hero compare to a noble vampire family?"
One of the Bloodgrave members mocked loudly.
Laughter spread immediately.
"HAHAHAHA!"
"Good."
"Now he understands reality."
Selene’s expression became worried and she tried to move forward—
But suddenly,
A murderous gaze locked onto her. She turned slightly.
Her stepmother stood there silently, her cold eyes delivering a clear warning..
Take one step—and lose your legs.
Selene clenched her fists tightly while looking toward the dust cloud where Luke crashed.
"...Please be safe."
But then—
CLICK.
CLANG.
CLICK-CLICK.
A strange metallic sound echoed from inside the smoke.
Like giant armor locking together piece by piece.
Everyone’s expressions changed.
Slowly—
All eyes turned toward the dust cloud.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Titan Knight Awakening II
paragraphs: As Lucien blasted Luke away, everyone immediately turned toward him.
Dust slowly drifted through the broken arena while pieces of shattered stone rolled across the ground.
Lucien stood there completely fine, as if the previous battle had left no wounds on him at all.
The crimson aura surrounding his body slowly intensified.
His silver hair, which had now turned crimson-red, swayed in the wind and made him look like an ancient vampire prince descending from legend.
A faint blood mist wrapped around his fingers while his red eyes glowed coldly.
"Wait—!"
"He is a Crimson Vampire Realm master!"
Someone from the crowd exclaimed loudly, and the entire arena gasped in shock. Everyone then looked again carefully, confirming what they had just heard.
Thin crimson veins could now be seen moving beneath Lucien’s pale skin while blood energy quietly circulated around his body.
"Becoming a Crimson Vampire at such a young age is the sign of a genius..."
Someone muttered in disbelief.
Then everyone turned toward the Bloodgrave family members who looked like proud swans lifting their heads toward the heavens.
Their mocking smiles became even wider.
"They sure know how to play."
"Seems like they were already preparing for this wedding from the start."
Selene’s expression became worried after seeing this.
The other four wives also exchanged glances before silently continuing to observe the duel.
The atmosphere around the arena slowly became heavier.
But then—
CLICK.
CLANG.
CLICK-CLICK.
A strange metallic sound echoed from inside the smoke cloud.
Like giant armor locking together piece by piece.
The sound was heavy and ancient, making everyone’s skin crawl instinctively.
2 Minutes Earlier.
As I got blasted away and crashed into the ground—
BOOOOM!
The impact shattered the arena wall behind me.
Stone debris buried half my body while cracks spread across the black stone floor.
My vision spun as blood continued to flow from my forehead, arms, and chest.
Fortunately, regeneration was helping me, but it still wasn’t enough.
I groaned in pain as I tried to stand up, but failed immediately, my muscles screaming in agony.
[Luke, use the Third Form now or he will beat the shit out of you.]
[He is already in Crimson Vampire Realm.]
The system’s voice sounded urgent for the first time.
I clenched my fist tightly.
"No one is going to touch my wife..."
I muttered and activated the Third Form, no longer caring about going berserk.
Present Time.
BOOOOOOOM!!!
Suddenly the entire ground exploded where Luke had fallen.
Stone fragments blasted into the air as a violent shockwave erupted outward, forcing several spectators near the front to stumble backward in fear.
ROOOOOAAAAARRRR!!!
A primal roar echoed across the training grounds, the sound alone shaking the air.
Then—

A giant figure slowly rose from within the smoke—twelve feet tall, with shoulder-length golden hair flowing wildly like a lion’s mane. His golden eyes burned with a savage ferocity, like that of an ancient beast. His chiseled body looked monstrous under the sunlight, while veins bulged beneath his skin like glowing golden roots.
The remains of his clothes barely covered him now.
CLICK.
RATTLE.
CLANGGGG.
Everyone’s eyes widened.
Behind the giant—

A massive black knight armor floated within the void itself. Twelve giant chains connected its armor pieces to Luke’s body. The chains rattled violently as the giant tried to pull them toward himself with brute force.
KRRRRR-CLANGGGG!!
But the armor did not move, as if it refused to acknowledge him—like a king rejecting an unworthy warrior.
ROOOOOARRR!!!
The giant roared angrily and finally released the chains before slowly turning his head around.
The pressure alone made nearby spectators pale, and several weaker nobles instinctively stepped backward.
Then—
The giant’s golden eyes landed on Lucien.
Lucien’s expression stiffened for the first time. Even his instincts were now screaming danger.
The giant slowly walked forward, each step shaking the training grounds.
THUD. THUD. THUD.
Cracks spread beneath his feet while dust jumped from the ground.
BOOOOOOM!!!
Suddenly, the giant charged forward, and the arena floor exploded beneath him instantly. A storm of dust followed behind his massive body.
Lucien’s face changed immediately.
SHWIIING!!
A massive blood barrier instantly formed before him, while crimson claws coated both of his arms. The air around him hissed violently with blood energy.
But—
BAAAAAAAAAANG!!!
The blood barrier shattered instantly like glass, and a massive shockwave erupted across the arena.
Lucien’s eyes widened in horror.
Then—
BOOOOOM!!!
Luke’s giant fist slammed directly into Lucien’s chest.
CRAAACKKK!!!
Several ribs broke instantly. Lucien’s body was blasted backward like a cannonball, smashing through walls, pillars, and barriers in succession.
CRASH!! CRASH!! BOOOOM!!
The spectators’ area trembled violently, and some nobles screamed as they retreated backward.
But the giant did not stop.
THOOOM!
He charged again, like a raging monster unleashed from its chains.
BAMMM!!!
Another punch.
BOOOOM!!!
Another.
KRAAAASHHH!!!
Another.
Lucien’s body was now being treated like a rag doll.
If the previous Luke looked like a grown man beating another man—
Then now—
It looked like a giant crushing a child without resistance.
The training grounds were already half-destroyed, with cracked walls and collapsed pillars as dust clouds filled the entire battlefield.
"Gulp..."
The sound of swallowing echoed everywhere. Nobody had expected this outcome.
"Is... this the Hero’s special gift?
Someone whispered with fear, but nobody answered.
Selene and the other wives looked toward Luke with shock and curiosity.
Especially the Dragon Princess—her golden draconic eyes narrowed slightly.
"Seems like our big boy has lost his mind..."
Rhaenyra muttered while smiling faintly.
ROOOOOOOAAAAARRRRR!!!
A savage roar exploded again.
Everyone’s faces instantly turned pale. Because—
The giant ripped Lucien’s heart out barehanded, blood splashing across the battlefield. Then, in front of everyone...
CRUNCH.
He bit directly into it.
"HAHAHAHAHA!!!"
The giant’s laughter echoed wildly across the destroyed arena.
Blood dripped from his mouth, while his savage expression made everyone feel instinctive fear. Several nobles nearly vomited.
The Bloodgrave family’s expressions turned ugly instantly, and murderous killing intent erupted from them.
Selene saw this and immediately tried to move toward Luke, but.
"Husband, you should not eat something raw or it will leave bad taste on your mouth."
A calm voice echoed suddenly.
Everyone turned toward the source of the voice and their expressions changed slightly.
A young woman with long crimson-red hair slowly walked forward.
Golden draconic eyes shimmered like molten gold beneath her sharp eyelashes while faint dragon scales could be seen near her pale neck and collarbone.
Two small black horns curved upward from her head, giving her overwhelming noble pressure.
She wore a black and crimson royal dress embroidered with golden dragon patterns.
Every step she took carried natural dominance.
The Dragon Princess—Rhaenyra Crimsonscale.
She appeared in front of Giant Luke and spoke normally, as if the terrifying battlefield pressure meant absolutely nothing to her.
ROOOOARRRR!!!
Luke immediately threw a wild punch toward her, the impact alone distorting the air.
BOOOOOOM!!!
"Sigh..."
Rhaenyra sighed softly, then raised a single palm.
PAH.
She caught his giant fist effortlessly, as if stopping a child.
SWOOOOSHHHH!!!
A violent pressure wave exploded outward from the impact. Her elegant dress fluttered wildly while the ground beneath her feet cracked deeply, but she did not move even an inch.
Then her draconic eyes glowed brightly as a terrifying ancient pressure descended across the entire training ground.
HUMMMMMMM

Everyone’s faces turned pale instantly, and even higher-ranked beings narrowed their eyes in seriousness. Only one thought echoed in their minds: no wonder dragons are called the strongest race in this world.

Just as the pressure descended, Luke let out a painful roar as his giant body slowly began to shrink. His golden hair faded and disappeared, and his body returned to normal—black hair, blue eyes, and a six-foot frame.
He swayed weakly for a second before collapsing forward, but Rhaenyra caught him effortlessly. Then she lifted him over her shoulder like a sack of potatoes.
After doing this, Rhaenyra spoke calmly. "Saintess, we are leaving now. It seems our work here is done."
The Saintess paused for a second before silently nodded.
Soon Selene and the other wives also followed behind her.
Meanwhile, the Bloodgrave family rushed toward Lucien’s broken body in panic. Healing mages immediately surrounded him, still hoping to preserve whatever talent remained within him.
The Human Emperor and Empress exchanged a glance silently.
SWOOSH.
The next second, they disappeared instantly.
Only the destroyed battlefield remained—broken pillars, blood staining the ground, and a crowd frozen in shock.
[Chapter End]

Dust slowly drifted through the broken arena while pieces of shattered stone rolled across the ground.
Lucien stood there completely fine, as if the previous battle had left no wounds on him at all.
The crimson aura surrounding his body slowly intensified.
His silver hair, which had now turned crimson-red, swayed in the wind and made him look like an ancient vampire prince descending from legend.
A faint blood mist wrapped around his fingers while his red eyes glowed coldly.
"Wait—!"
"He is a Crimson Vampire Realm master!"
Someone from the crowd exclaimed loudly, and the entire arena gasped in shock.
Everyone then looked again carefully, confirming what they had just heard.
Thin crimson veins could now be seen moving beneath Lucien’s pale skin while blood energy quietly circulated around his body.
"Becoming a Crimson Vampire at such a young age is the sign of a genius..."
Someone muttered in disbelief.
Then everyone turned toward the Bloodgrave family members who looked like proud swans lifting their heads toward the heavens.
Their mocking smiles became even wider.
"They sure know how to play."
"Seems like they were already preparing for this wedding from the start."
Selene’s expression became worried after seeing this.
The other four wives also exchanged glances before silently continuing to observe the duel.
The atmosphere around the arena slowly became heavier.
But then—
CLICK.
CLANG.
CLICK-CLICK.
A strange metallic sound echoed from inside the smoke cloud.
Like giant armor locking together piece by piece.
The sound was heavy and ancient, making everyone’s skin crawl instinctively.
2 Minutes Earlier.
As I got blasted away and crashed into the ground—
BOOOOM!
The impact shattered the arena wall behind me.
Stone debris buried half my body while cracks spread across the black stone floor.
My vision spun as blood continued to flow from my forehead, arms, and chest.
Fortunately, regeneration was helping me, but it still wasn’t enough.
I groaned in pain as I tried to stand up, but failed immediately, my muscles screaming in agony.
[Luke, use the Third Form now or he will beat the shit out of you.]
[He is already in Crimson Vampire Realm.]
The system’s voice sounded urgent for the first time.
I clenched my fist tightly.
"No one is going to touch my wife..."
I muttered and activated the Third Form, no longer caring about going berserk.
Present Time.
BOOOOOOOM!!!
Suddenly the entire ground exploded where Luke had fallen.
Stone fragments blasted into the air as a violent shockwave erupted outward, forcing several spectators near the front to stumble backward in fear.
ROOOOOAAAAARRRR!!!
A primal roar echoed across the training grounds, the sound alone shaking the air.
Then—
A giant figure slowly rose from within the smoke—twelve feet tall, with shoulder-length golden hair flowing wildly like a lion’s mane.
His golden eyes burned with a savage ferocity, like that of an ancient beast.
His chiseled body looked monstrous under the sunlight, while veins bulged beneath his skin like glowing golden roots.
The remains of his clothes barely covered him now.
CLICK.
RATTLE.
CLANGGGG.
Everyone’s eyes widened.
Behind the giant—
A massive black knight armor floated within the void itself.
Twelve giant chains connected its armor pieces to Luke’s body.
The chains rattled violently as the giant tried to pull them toward himself with brute force.
KRRRRR-CLANGGGG!!
But the armor did not move, as if it refused to acknowledge him—like a king rejecting an unworthy warrior.
ROOOOOARRR!!!
The giant roared angrily and finally released the chains before slowly turning his head around.
The pressure alone made nearby spectators pale, and several weaker nobles instinctively stepped backward.
Then—
The giant’s golden eyes landed on Lucien.
Lucien’s expression stiffened for the first time.
Even his instincts were now screaming danger.
The giant slowly walked forward, each step shaking the training grounds.
THUD.
THUD.
THUD.
Cracks spread beneath his feet while dust jumped from the ground.
BOOOOOOM!!!
Suddenly, the giant charged forward, and the arena floor exploded beneath him instantly.
A storm of dust followed behind his massive body.
Lucien’s face changed immediately.
SHWIIING!!
A massive blood barrier instantly formed before him, while crimson claws coated both of his arms.
The air around him hissed violently with blood energy.
But—
BAAAAAAAAAANG!!!
The blood barrier shattered instantly like glass, and a massive shockwave erupted across the arena.
Lucien’s eyes widened in horror.
Then—
BOOOOOM!!!
Luke’s giant fist slammed directly into Lucien’s chest.
CRAAACKKK!!!
Several ribs broke instantly.
Lucien’s body was blasted backward like a cannonball, smashing through walls, pillars, and barriers in succession.
CRASH!!
CRASH!!
BOOOOM!!
The spectators’ area trembled violently, and some nobles screamed as they retreated backward.
But the giant did not stop.
THOOOM!
He charged again, like a raging monster unleashed from its chains.
BAMMM!!!
Another punch.
BOOOOM!!!
Another.
KRAAAASHHH!!!
Another.
Lucien’s body was now being treated like a rag doll.
If the previous Luke looked like a grown man beating another man—
Then now—
It looked like a giant crushing a child without resistance.
The training grounds were already half-destroyed, with cracked walls and collapsed pillars as dust clouds filled the entire battlefield.
"Gulp..."
The sound of swallowing echoed everywhere.
Nobody had expected this outcome.
"Is... this the Hero’s special gift?
Someone whispered with fear, but nobody answered.
Selene and the other wives looked toward Luke with shock and curiosity.
Especially the Dragon Princess—her golden draconic eyes narrowed slightly.
"Seems like our big boy has lost his mind..."
Rhaenyra muttered while smiling faintly.
ROOOOOOOAAAAARRRRR!!!
A savage roar exploded again.
Everyone’s faces instantly turned pale.
Because—
The giant ripped Lucien’s heart out barehanded, blood splashing across the battlefield.
Then, in front of everyone...
CRUNCH.
He bit directly into it.
"HAHAHAHAHA!!!"
The giant’s laughter echoed wildly across the destroyed arena.
Blood dripped from his mouth, while his savage expression made everyone feel instinctive fear.
Several nobles nearly vomited.
The Bloodgrave family’s expressions turned ugly instantly, and murderous killing intent erupted from them.
Selene saw this and immediately tried to move toward Luke, but.
"Husband, you should not eat something raw or it will leave bad taste on your mouth."
A calm voice echoed suddenly.
Everyone turned toward the source of the voice and their expressions changed slightly.
A young woman with long crimson-red hair slowly walked forward.
Golden draconic eyes shimmered like molten gold beneath her sharp eyelashes while faint dragon scales could be seen near her pale neck and collarbone.
Two small black horns curved upward from her head, giving her overwhelming noble pressure.
She wore a black and crimson royal dress embroidered with golden dragon patterns.
Every step she took carried natural dominance.
The Dragon Princess—Rhaenyra Crimsonscale.
She appeared in front of Giant Luke and spoke normally, as if the terrifying battlefield pressure meant absolutely nothing to her.
ROOOOARRRR!!!
Luke immediately threw a wild punch toward her, the impact alone distorting the air.
BOOOOOOM!!!
"Sigh..."
Rhaenyra sighed softly, then raised a single palm.
PAH.
She caught his giant fist effortlessly, as if stopping a child.
SWOOOOSHHHH!!!
A violent pressure wave exploded outward from the impact.
Her elegant dress fluttered wildly while the ground beneath her feet cracked deeply, but she did not move even an inch.
Then her draconic eyes glowed brightly as a terrifying ancient pressure descended across the entire training ground.
HUMMMMMMM
Everyone’s faces turned pale instantly, and even higher-ranked beings narrowed their eyes in seriousness.
Only one thought echoed in their minds: no wonder dragons are called the strongest race in this world.
Just as the pressure descended, Luke let out a painful roar as his giant body slowly began to shrink.
His golden hair faded and disappeared, and his body returned to normal—black hair, blue eyes, and a six-foot frame.
He swayed weakly for a second before collapsing forward, but Rhaenyra caught him effortlessly.
Then she lifted him over her shoulder like a sack of potatoes.
After doing this, Rhaenyra spoke calmly.
"Saintess, we are leaving now.
It seems our work here is done."
The Saintess paused for a second before silently nodded.
Soon Selene and the other wives also followed behind her.
Meanwhile, the Bloodgrave family rushed toward Lucien’s broken body in panic.
Healing mages immediately surrounded him, still hoping to preserve whatever talent remained within him.
The Human Emperor and Empress exchanged a glance silently.
SWOOSH.
The next second, they disappeared instantly.
Only the destroyed battlefield remained—broken pillars, blood staining the ground, and a crowd frozen in shock.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Chains No One Desired
paragraphs: After they left the temple, they boarded a massive airship shaped like an ancient sailing vessel.
The giant ship floated silently in the sky, its dark wooden body reinforced with silver metal plates glowing faintly with magical runes.
On both sides of the ship were enormous wing-like structures made from an unknown crystal material, helping the airship remain afloat in the air.
At the back, several fin-shaped structures slowly adjusted themselves, controlling the direction of the ship as it moved through the clouds.
And at the very center of the vessel—
A gigantic blue crystal was embedded deep into the core of the ship.
The crystal pulsed rhythmically like a living heart, releasing waves of mana throughout the airship. It was the main power source.
Soon after boarding, the five women entered a large private room together while servants quietly moved outside preparing the ship.
RUMBLE—
The massive airship slowly rose into the sky before leaving the floating island behind.
If someone looked back now, they would see the holy temple standing on an enormous floating continent suspended high above the clouds.
The sight looked almost divine.
After entering the room, Rhaenyra casually dropped Luke onto the bed.
His condition looked miserable. Only the remains of his ripped pants covered him, while bruises and dried blood marks remained across his body.
The five women silently took their seats around the room.
For a few moments—
Silence.
Only the faint humming sound of the airship engine echoed in the background.
Then—
"So... what now?"
Rhaenyra asked while leaning lazily against her chair, crossing her long legs casually.
Her draconic golden eyes slowly swept across the room.
Selene immediately gave her a sharp look and spoke seriously. "We need to protect him," she said, before lightly touching her chest. "Our lives are also connected to him now."
The moment those words were spoken—
Everyone’s expressions darkened slightly.
Even Selene herself hated this situation.
Because none of them chose this.
Then—
"Why would the Goddess bind us like this?" Elaria Moonleaf suddenly asked, her expression faintly fuming.
Her long silver-blonde hair flowed down to her waist like strands of moonlight, while her emerald-green eyes carried visible frustration toward the Goddess herself.
"This never happened with previous Heroes."
The atmosphere inside the room grew heavier, and no one had an answer to that question.
Rhaenyra looked at Luke’s sleeping face for a moment, her draconic golden eyes fixed on him in silence before she slowly shook her head.
A faint sigh escaped her lips as she said, "I don’t have time for this." Her voice grew heavier than before as she added, "I still need to fight the demons that invaded my territory..."
She paused for a second before adding, "...and also find a way to break these chains."
The moment those final words left her mouth—
Everyone’s expressions changed instantly, because these chains were cast by the Goddess herself. Even speaking about breaking them felt almost blasphemous.
Rhaenyra noticed everyone’s reactions and suddenly laughed.
"Hahaha..."
But there was no joy in her laughter—only pride, cold and untamed pride.
"Do you really think someone can control me?" she asked as a faint draconic pressure leaked from her body. Her golden eyes narrowed slightly.
"I am a proud Dragon."
"I would rather die than stay bound to someone unworthy of me."
The room became quieter after those words, and even the air itself felt heavier. Then, without waiting for anyone’s reply, Rhaenyra turned around.
CREAK—
The door opened, and she left. Silence covered the room once more, broken only by the low humming of the airship in the background.
Then—
"I will also check the records of my ancestors..." Elaria suddenly spoke softly, "...if the World Tree can help."
Her voice slowed slightly before her emerald eyes shifted toward Luke, who was still groaning faintly in his sleep like he was trapped inside a nightmare.
"...then maybe I can break these chains too."A complicated emotion flickered inside her eyes.
Then she slowly stood up, her silver-blonde hair swaying gently behind her like flowing moonlight. Without saying another word, she also left the room.
Now only three people remained, and the atmosphere became even quieter than before.
Naivara Tidewhisper gently lifted the crystal glass in her hand before finally breaking the silence.
The soft blue liquid inside reflected against her silver-blue eyes.
Her long aqua-blue hair flowed over her shoulders like calm ocean waves, while the pearl chains around her waist gave faint clinking sounds whenever she moved.
"Even though the Goddess forced this marriage on me..." she spoke calmly, but a trace of helplessness was hidden beneath her graceful tone.
She slowly looked toward Luke, who was still groaning unconsciously in his sleep, his eyebrows twitching slightly as if he were suffering through painful dreams.
"Our traditions do not allow an unworthy man to become a princess’s partner," she said, before letting out a soft sigh.
"Even if I accept him..." a faint bitterness appeared in her eyes as she added, "...my father never will.
For a brief moment, silence filled the room again.
Then Naivara slowly stood up from her seat, the translucent layers of her ocean dress swaying gently as she walked toward the door.
Without turning back, she left as well.
Now only Selene and Aurielle remained.
Selene stared quietly toward the closed door for a few seconds.
Then, slowly, she stood up and walked toward Luke.
Luke was still groaning faintly in his sleep. "...nn..." His face looked restless, as if he were afraid of being abandoned again.
Selene’s expression softened slightly as she watched him. She slowly sat beside him on the bed and gently ran her fingers through his hair.
Her cold hand carefully brushed against his forehead as if trying to calm him down.
"...Even if I wanted to..." her voice grew quieter as she continued, "...I can’t stay with him," a trace of pain flashing through her crimson eyes.
Then she leaned slightly forward and placed a small kiss on Luke’s forehead, a faint warmth appearing on her usually pale expression.
After that, she finally spoke toward Aurielle without looking away from Luke.
"If I leave the Academy..." she paused softly, "...the promise will end." Her voice lowered as she continued, "...and my family..."
Her fingers tightened slightly as she added, "...they will definitely come for his life as well."
The room became silent for a moment, and then Selene slowly turned toward Aurielle.
For the first time since entering the room, there was genuine pleading in her eyes.
"So please..." "Protect him." After saying those final words, Selene slowly stood up and left the room.
CREAK—
The door closed once more, leaving only Aurielle in the room.
"...Sigh." A heavy, exhausted sigh escaped from her lips.
She slowly looked toward Luke, lying unconscious on the bed, and said softly, "I’m barely managing to survive myself..." "...and now I have to protect you too."
She muttered tiredly before slumping deeper into her chair.
Her purple eyes slowly lifted toward the ceiling as the proud royal composure she had maintained earlier gradually faded, leaving only exhaustion behind.
Then—
Her eyes slowly became moist as she whispered something so quietly that no one else could hear it.
"...I will definitely save you, Mother." A small tear slid down her cheek, dripping softly onto the floor.
Then slowly—
Exhaustion finally overtook her, and she quietly fell asleep in the chair beside Luke’s bed.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Debt Collector Arrives
paragraphs: DINNGG—
I heard the system’s voice and, with a groan, slowly opened my eyes while rubbing them.
As I looked around, I found myself inside an unfamiliar room roughly the size of ten by ten.
The room was simple, with a wooden bed, a small table beside it, and faint candlelight flickering against the wall.
My clothes had also been changed, and I was now wearing a simple linen shirt and loose pants.
"Ughh..."
I clutched my head as pain surged through it and tried to remember what happened, but everything after the fight felt blurry.
"I used the third form of Titan Knight..." "...after that, my memory is blank," I muttered while slowly massaging my forehead, trying to reduce the pain.
[Luke, you finally woke up.]
The system’s voice suddenly echoed inside my mind, pulling me out of my thoughts.
"What happened?" I asked immediately.
[You lost control. Then you defeated Lucien.]
[After that, your dragon wife suppressed you and everyone left the temple.]
"...I see," I let out a small sigh before reaching for the glass of water beside the bed.
GULP.
GULP.
Cold water slid down my throat, calming my dry mouth slightly.
DINGG!
[Luke, you have shocked all 5 of your wives.]
[10x Return Activated.]
[Reward Granted.]
The moment I heard that, my tired expression instantly brightened.
I quickly opened the system inventory.
F-Rank Item —
[Mana Wheat Seeds ×10]
[Description:
Crops capable of growing in low mana environments. Slightly improves stamina and recovery when consumed.]
System:
[Do not underestimate agriculture.]
Inside the inventory were ten large bags filled with glowing pale-golden seeds.
"This is great," I nodded in satisfaction after reading the description. With this, even a poor territory could slowly become self-sufficient.
Though I completely ignored the system’s strange advice, I then checked the next reward.
F-Rank Utility Item —
[Aqua Spring Crystal ×10]
[Description:
A low-grade mana crystal capable of continuously generating clean fresh water.]
System:
[Even kings starve without resources.]
A small blue crystal appeared in my hand, and the moment I touched it, a cold, refreshing feeling spread through my fingers.
"With this, growing Mana Wheat will become much easier," a smile slowly appeared on my face. Then I moved toward the next reward.
F-Rank Item —
[Body Tempering Potion ×10]
[Description:
A beginner alchemical potion capable of accelerating progress through the Body Tempering Realm.]
[Warning.]
[Ordinary Body Tempering Potions contain toxin residue.]
[System rewards are perfectly refined and free from impurities.]
My eyes widened slightly after reading that. "Doesn’t this mean..." "...I can finally start cultivating the Knight Path properly and become stronger?"
{Knight Paths:
🔹 1. Body Tempering Realm
🔹 2. Iron Knight Realm
🔹 3. Bronze Knight Realm
🔹 4. Silver Knight Realm
Etc.}
I muttered with a shocked expression, as in novels and comics, normal alchemical potions always left toxin buildup inside the body after repeated use.
But this one had no side effects at all. "...So this is what counts as premium quality?" I asked, genuinely curious.
System:
[Correction.]
[This is perfection.]
"...You really sound like a salesman sometimes," I muttered under my breath.
But honestly, I couldn’t even argue back. Finally, I checked the next reward.
[Gold Coin Pouch ×10]
[Total:
1,000 Gold Coins]
The moment I saw that amount, my eyes nearly popped out.
"...I’m rich."
System:
[Incorrect.]
[You are no longer poor.]
"...Fair enough," I clicked my tongue and ignored its mockery, even though it was completely true.
Then finally, I rubbed my hands together and began praying dramatically.
"Oh Goddess of Luck..." I muttered, "...please give your poor Hero something useful."
[If goddess of light heard that you are praying to another goddess, she will spank you for sure.]
System voice filled with mockery come the moment my prayer finished, on which my face become ugly.
DINGG!
[Reward Granted.]
F-Rank Item —
[Apprentice Mage Recruitment Scroll ×10]
[Description:
Allows the recruitment of ten random second-stage mages.]
{Mage Paths:
🔹 1. Mana Awakening Realm
🔹 2. Apprentice Mage Realm
🔹 3. Circle Mage Realm
Etc.}

Seeing the reward made me freeze, and then my eyes lit up at once. Because in this world, even low-level mages were treated like treasures—kingdoms fought over them while nobles spent fortunes trying to recruit them. And now I had ten.
"System... you are the best," I said excitedly.
[I know.]
[So hurry up and make all of them fall in love with you.]
The system replied with a shameless tone.
"I am loyal only to my wife" I said with righteous expression then looked toward the scrolls inside my hands.
"Huff..." I took a deep breath and activated them.
FLASH—
One magic circle appeared after another across the room floor, and blue light illuminated the entire room.
WHOOSH—
Mana swirled gently in the air as ten young women emerged from the glowing circles, nervously holding staffs.
Some looked confused, others curious, and a few frightened, and each of them wore simple mage robes with different colored patterns depending on their affinity.
Then I checked their appearance one by one, along with their abilities.
{Author’s Note: All ten mages are introduced here. Feel free to skip, but they will appear often later in the story.}
Nature Mage
Name:
Luna
Green hair ribbon, gentle personality.
Appearance:
Short green hair, bright green eyes, and a soft smile.
She wears light brown and green robes with a wooden staff wrapped in vines.
Abilities:
* crop growth
* herb care
* mana plant nurturing
Water Mage
Name:
Mira
Quiet blue-haired girl.
Appearance:
Long blue hair tied behind her back, pale blue eyes, and smooth fair skin.
She wears simple blue robes and carries a thin crystal staff.
Abilities:
* water generation
* purification
* irrigation support
Earth Mage
Name:
Tara
Short brown-haired girl.
Abilities:
* wall reinforcement
* soil shaping
* construction support
Appearance:
Brown shoulder-length hair, amber eyes, and a calm expression.
She wears dark beige robes with sturdy leather boots.
Fire Mage
Name:
Rin
Red-haired energetic girl.
Abilities:
* furnace control
* combat sparks
* ore smelting
Appearance:
Short red hair, orange eyes, and an energetic smile.
She wears black-and-red robes slightly burned near the sleeves.
Wind Mage
Name:
Sylvi
Silver-haired cheerful girl.
Abilities:
* message delivery
* wind blades
* scouting support
Appearance:
Silver short hair, light gray eyes, and a cheerful face.
She wears light white robes that flutter constantly from her own wind mana.
Barrier Mage
Name:
Nora
Black-haired calm girl.
Abilities:
* weak magic shields
* alarm barriers
* defensive wards
Appearance:
Long black hair, dark blue eyes, and a quiet expression.
She wears dark navy robes and carries a square-tipped staff.
🌿 Herb Mage
Name:
Fina
Freckled green-eyed girl.
Abilities:
* potion ingredient knowledge
* medicinal herb cultivation
* toxin detection
Appearance:
Light brown hair braided to one side, green eyes, and freckles near her cheeks.
She wears pale green robes with herb pouches hanging from her waist.
Lightning Mage
Name:
Veya
Sharp-eyed purple-haired girl.
Abilities:
* stun magic
* electrical sparks
* fast casting support
Appearance:
Dark purple hair, sharp violet eyes, and a confident look.
She wears black-and-purple robes with silver thread patterns.
Shadow Mage
Name:
Lyra
Dark blue-haired quiet girl.
Abilities:
* concealment
* night scouting
* shadow movement support
Appearance:
Dark blue hair, pale skin, and deep gray eyes.
She wears loose dark robes that almost blend into shadows.
I smiled when I thought about these numbers, but sadly I had to teach them magic by myself or use some scrolls.
"Because they only know small tricks right now and have no combat abilities," I said, shaking my head with regret.
But among them, one girl immediately stood out.
The Light Mage.
She had soft golden-blonde hair, gentle amber eyes, and an almost holy atmosphere around her despite being only an apprentice mage.
Even the faint light gathering around her staff looked warmer than the others, and unlike the others, she quietly held her gaze on me a little longer.
I got curious and check her description.
Light Apprentice Mage (Special)
Name:
Elena Whitmore
Appearance:
A beautiful young woman with long blonde hair, soft golden eyes, and fair skin.
She wears simple white apprentice robes with light golden patterns near the sleeves and carries a silver staff with a small glowing crystal attached at the top.
Her gentle aura naturally makes people feel calm around her.
Specialty:
* healing wounds
* fatigue recovery
* light purification
* stabilizing mana
"Wow," I was surprised, because even the system tagged her as special.
"Well, at least now I have a healer," I smiled, then looked at all of them. But then suddenly, all ten of them knelt together.
"Greetings, Master," their soft voices echoed throughout the room.
"Uh... hello."
I awkwardly greeted them back before quickly telling them to stand up, since I already knew they were loyal because of the system.
But before I could continue speaking-
KNOCK.
KNOCK.
A knock came from the door, and a young male voice echoed from outside.
"Young Master... if you are awake, then the Lord is summoning you."
I paused for a moment and looked toward the mages behind me before answering.
"Alright."
Then I walked toward the door and opened it, revealing a young man with short black hair dressed in a worker’s uniform standing outside.
But the moment he looked past me and saw ten beautiful female mages standing inside the room—
He froze. "...Eh?" Then his eyes widened slightly before he immediately lowered his head nervously.
I pretended not to notice his reaction.
"Lead the way."
As we walked through the corridors, both me and the mages curiously observed the surroundings.
The hallways of the mansion were surprisingly luxurious, with lamps glowing softly along the walls.
Servants and maids walking nearby secretly glanced toward us repeatedly, especially at the ten mages following behind me.
After all, each of them possessed different hair colors, distinct magical auras, and above-average beauty, naturally attracting attention instantly.
But no one dared to approach.
"...Seems like they already know about me," I muttered quietly as I noticed the cautious gazes directed toward me.

The young worker bowed slightly and said, "The Lord is inside."

CREEEAK—

Aurielle Valmont.
She was dressed in simple linen robes today instead of royal clothes, yet she still carried an elegant noble aura naturally.
Beside her stood an elderly woman wearing a maid outfit.
The old maid smiled warmly the moment she saw me enter.
I awkwardly returned the smile.
Soon Aurielle’s gaze also shifted toward me.
Though unlike the maid—
She didn’t smile.
Instead, she calmly asked,
"...Are you feeling better now?"
Her voice sounded tired.
But there was still concern hidden beneath it.
"Yeah."
I scratched my cheek lightly before smiling.
"Much better now."
"...And thanks for taking care of me."
Aurielle paused briefly after hearing that.
Then she quietly nodded and returned to her paperwork again.
"...Good."
The room became silent for a brief moment.
Only the sound of papers turning could be heard.
But suddenly—
BANG!
The office door abruptly opened.
A middle-aged man with messy brown hair rushed inside while breathing heavily.
Sweat covered his forehead.
His expression looked panicked.
Everyone inside the room immediately turned toward him.
The man swallowed hard before hurriedly speaking.
"L-Lord..."
He took a short breath.
"...the noble is here."
Aurielle’s writing hand stopped instantly.
The atmosphere inside the room changed slightly.
Then the man continued nervously.
"...He came to collect the loan."

sentences.text: DINNGG—
I heard the system’s voice and, with a groan, slowly opened my eyes while rubbing them.
As I looked around, I found myself inside an unfamiliar room roughly the size of ten by ten.
The room was simple, with a wooden bed, a small table beside it, and faint candlelight flickering against the wall.
My clothes had also been changed, and I was now wearing a simple linen shirt and loose pants.
"Ughh..."
I clutched my head as pain surged through it and tried to remember what happened, but everything after the fight felt blurry.
"I used the third form of Titan Knight..." "...after that, my memory is blank," I muttered while slowly massaging my forehead, trying to reduce the pain.
[Luke, you finally woke up.]
The system’s voice suddenly echoed inside my mind, pulling me out of my thoughts.
"What happened?" I asked immediately.
[You lost control.
Then you defeated Lucien.]
[After that, your dragon wife suppressed you and everyone left the temple.]
"...I see," I let out a small sigh before reaching for the glass of water beside the bed.
GULP.
GULP.
Cold water slid down my throat, calming my dry mouth slightly.
DINGG!
[Luke, you have shocked all 5 of your wives.]
[10x Return Activated.]
[Reward Granted.]
The moment I heard that, my tired expression instantly brightened.
I quickly opened the system inventory.
F-Rank Item —
[Mana Wheat Seeds ×10]
[Description:
Crops capable of growing in low mana environments.
Slightly improves stamina and recovery when consumed.]
System:
[Do not underestimate agriculture.]
Inside the inventory were ten large bags filled with glowing pale-golden seeds.
"This is great," I nodded in satisfaction after reading the description.
With this, even a poor territory could slowly become self-sufficient.
Though I completely ignored the system’s strange advice, I then checked the next reward.
F-Rank Utility Item —
[Aqua Spring Crystal ×10]
[Description:
A low-grade mana crystal capable of continuously generating clean fresh water.]
System:
[Even kings starve without resources.]
A small blue crystal appeared in my hand, and the moment I touched it, a cold, refreshing feeling spread through my fingers.
"With this, growing Mana Wheat will become much easier," a smile slowly appeared on my face.
Then I moved toward the next reward.
F-Rank Item —
[Body Tempering Potion ×10]
[Description:
A beginner alchemical potion capable of accelerating progress through the Body Tempering Realm.]
[Warning.]
[Ordinary Body Tempering Potions contain toxin residue.]
[System rewards are perfectly refined and free from impurities.]
My eyes widened slightly after reading that.
"Doesn’t this mean..." "...I can finally start cultivating the Knight Path properly and become stronger?"
{Knight Paths:
Body Tempering Realm
Iron Knight Realm
Bronze Knight Realm
Silver Knight Realm
Etc.}
I muttered with a shocked expression, as in novels and comics, normal alchemical potions always left toxin buildup inside the body after repeated use.
But this one had no side effects at all.
"...So this is what counts as premium quality?" I asked, genuinely curious.
System:
[Correction.]
[This is perfection.]
"...You really sound like a salesman sometimes," I muttered under my breath.
But honestly, I couldn’t even argue back.
Finally, I checked the next reward.
[Gold Coin Pouch ×10]
[Total:
1,000 Gold Coins]
The moment I saw that amount, my eyes nearly popped out.
"...I’m rich."
System:
[Incorrect.]
[You are no longer poor.]
"...Fair enough," I clicked my tongue and ignored its mockery, even though it was completely true.
Then finally, I rubbed my hands together and began praying dramatically.
"Oh Goddess of Luck..." I muttered, "...please give your poor Hero something useful."
[If goddess of light heard that you are praying to another goddess, she will spank you for sure.]
System voice filled with mockery come the moment my prayer finished, on which my face become ugly.
DINGG!
[Reward Granted.]
F-Rank Item —
[Apprentice Mage Recruitment Scroll ×10]
[Description:
Allows the recruitment of ten random second-stage mages.]
{Mage Paths:
Mana Awakening Realm
Apprentice Mage Realm
Circle Mage Realm
Etc.}
Seeing the reward made me freeze, and then my eyes lit up at once.
Because in this world, even low-level mages were treated like treasures—kingdoms fought over them while nobles spent fortunes trying to recruit them.
And now I had ten.
"System... you are the best," I said excitedly.
[I know.]
[So hurry up and make all of them fall in love with you.]
The system replied with a shameless tone.
"I am loyal only to my wife" I said with righteous expression then looked toward the scrolls inside my hands.
"Huff..." I took a deep breath and activated them.
FLASH—
One magic circle appeared after another across the room floor, and blue light illuminated the entire room.
WHOOSH—
Mana swirled gently in the air as ten young women emerged from the glowing circles, nervously holding staffs.
Some looked confused, others curious, and a few frightened, and each of them wore simple mage robes with different colored patterns depending on their affinity.
