Every Origin was bestowed randomly, which was why all of those methods were merely possibilities rather than certainties.
Because—
"Even the Gods cannot bestow an Origin."
There was only one entity capable of bestowing an Origin—
The Origin of the World itself.
"Valtharion."
A low whisper escaped his mouth.
The Brown Glove assassins holding him frowned in confusion, unable to hear what he had said clearly.
However, the Silver Glove assassin standing in the distance heard it perfectly.
His pupils instantly dilated.
The next moment, he raised his hand and prepared to kill the knight on the spot.
But it was already too late.
The fire burning fiercely within his eyes suddenly transformed into something else.
"Spirit Owl."
The moment the last word left his mouth, a thunderous owl screech echoed throughout the vicinity.
SKREEEAAAHHHH—!!!
In the next second, a huge owl spirit nearly two meters tall appeared high in the sky.
With the moon shining behind it, the spirit seemed even more ethereal and majestic.
The Silver Glove assassin was momentarily distracted by the thunderous screech, causing his aim to falter.
The throwing dagger veered off course and struck the ground to the side without injuring anyone.
"Damn it."
He cursed under his breath.
Because in the very next second, the fifteen sleeping knights suddenly sprang to their feet.
Powerful bronze auras erupted from their bodies as they freely released their Third and Fourth Stage Bronze Knight cultivation.
Their weapons were already drawn as they scanned their surroundings with vigilance.
The owl spirit descended from the sky and instantly reached the knight.
With a single sweep of its massive wings, it sent both assassins flying to the side.
THUD!
THUD!
In the next moment, the spirit merged into the knight’s body.
A brilliant brown light erupted from him, illuminating the surrounding area.
Then another screech echoed through the night.
SKREEEAAAHHHH—!!!
As the brown light faded, a hybrid figure emerged from within.
He possessed a human body, but large owl wings extended from his back, while his face had taken on the features of an owl.
With a single flap of his wings, he shot into the sky.
The force of it caused the surrounding trees to sway violently.
Then his voice thundered across the entire campsite.
"IT’S AN AMBUSH!!!"
Then he shouted loudly.
Upon hearing his warning, the knights finally turned toward his direction.
Their expressions immediately changed as they discovered more than ten black-robed figures restraining their fellow knights.
Without a moment’s hesitation, all of them hurled their short swords toward the assassins.
SWOOSH!
SWOOSH!
SWOOSH!
"Fall back!"
The Silver Glove assassin shouted the order.
The Brown Glove assassins immediately released the captured knights and retreated while dodging the incoming short swords.
BOOM!
A thunderous impact echoed through the area as the Owl Hybrid descended from the sky and crashed onto the ground.
The force of the landing shattered the earth beneath his feet.
Then he stepped forward and assumed a fighting stance while shouting.
"Protect the Master!"
CLANG!
STEP!
THUD!
The knights behind him moved as one.
They swung their swords forward in a show of force before taking a heavy step.
The ground beneath them trembled slightly from the combined impact.
My eyes snapped open as a loud screech echoed through the night.
"A bird?"
I muttered in confusion.
At the same time, Aurielle was jolted awake and immediately turned toward the outside with a wary expression.
Just as we were about to stand up to check, another voice echoed from outside.
It sounded strange, as if a human voice had been mixed with the cry of a bird.
"IT’S AN AMBUSH!!!"
My eyes narrowed and without hesitation, I charged outside.
Aurielle also moved alongside me, and a purple sword appeared in her hand from her spatial ring.
"Voidfang."
I summoned my longsword as well.
A few moments later, we arrived at the scene.
My knights were already standing in formation with their weapons drawn.
Meanwhile, the four injured knights were retreating toward the rear, staggering as they struggled to remain on their feet.
"They’re injured."
I muttered as I noticed blood leaking from their stomachs.
However, my attention was soon drawn to the figure standing at the front.
It was an owl-like hybrid man.
Yet despite his appearance, he was still wearing the armor of Blackstone Territory.
Then my gaze shifted past him toward the enemy ahead.
Several black-robed men stood before us with their auras fully unleashed.
Most of them were at the Peak Bronze Knight stage.
However, the man standing at the front radiated the aura of an Early Silver Knight.
"This is bad."
I muttered after realizing how grim the situation was.
Then another thought suddenly crossed my mind.
"Who sent these assassins?
Baron Cedric?
Or Ashenford?"
I muttered while staring at the black-robed figures before me.
Beside me, Aurielle’s thoughts were moving in a completely different direction.
"Did they finally decide to remove me?"
A trace of sadness appeared on her face.
Then she turned her gaze toward the man who had entered her life.
Her only husband.
His face was grim as he observed the battlefield, clearly worried about everyone around him.
I will protect him at all costs.
With that final vow, Aurielle shifted her gaze toward the enemy group.
"Aurielle, help the knights.
I’ll handle the Silver Knight."
I spoke without taking my eyes off the assassins.
The moment she heard those words, her expression changed.
"No."
She immediately shook her head.
"I’m not letting you do that!"
"This is suicide!"
Aurielle shouted the moment she heard my words.
However, I simply shook my head.
Then I looked into her eyes, which were filled with love and concern for me, then I said in a gentle tone.
"Don’t worry, I will handle it."
On hearing my words, her expression didn’t relax at all, so I added.
"So how about this?
Deal with those Bronze Assassins as quickly as possible, then come help me, okay?"
After hearing my words, she hesitated for a few seconds before reluctantly nodding.
Soon, I reached the front line with Voidfang firmly gripped in my hand.
I knew my knights were willing to die for me.
But I didn’t want them to die.
So—
I raised my sword and pointed it toward the Silver Knight.
Then, I fully released my aura.
However, if someone were watching this scene, they would probably laugh at such apparent stupidity.
After all, a First Stage Iron Knight pointing his sword at an Early Silver Knight was nothing short of foolish.
To most people, it would look like a lamb challenging a wolf.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 37: The Night Swallows All
paragraphs: As we faced each other, everyone summoned their Aether to coat their bodies, on which a thin layer of bronze-colored Aether can be seen on most, but the silver assassin didn’t summon his Aether.
Then I took a deep breath and spoke in a deep voice.
"Nyx Ascension."
The next moment, my body starts growing, and all my clothes also rip apart while my hair becomes long and dark blue and my eyes turn azure blue.
Soon a twelve-foot, lean-bodied giant with his short pants appeared on the battlefield, but everyone could see night had suddenly become darker.
All the bronze-gloved assassins got stunned from this and back way a little, while the silver assassin didn’t even flinch.
Aurielle looked from the side and also got surprised because last time Luke summoned a muscular giant with golden hair.
Then everyone heard giant Luke’s low voice, "Descend, Velzareth."
CLICK CLACK CLANG.
In an instant a dark black armor with blue runes appeared behind Luke and, one by one, attached to its body.

I felt my body as now it’s fully armed, then looked toward them and said, "Now we are talking." Then I released my aura, which still belongs to the iron knight, but my suppression is around early bronze knight.
The silver assassin watched all of this with a curious expression, and finally, he uttered a word.
"An origin skill? Or something else?"
On which I paused slightly, because his voice seems rough but with static as well, and then he continued with a nonchalant voice, like I am not here at all.
"Because even God can’t give Origin skill," he finally finished, but I can feel his voice seems to hold a little bit of curiosity.

I don’t care about his talks, but he seems to be using some type of artifact, then I look around, as my knights are on high morale, while enemy peak bronze assassins are already showing signs of wariness.

Then my gaze turns toward the surroundings, as everywhere is only silence. "It looks like every beast or living being has escaped the vicinity. " I thought before turning toward Silver Assassin, who has brought out a silver sword from his spatial ring.
I tilted my head slightly after seeing this and said it in a mocking tone.
"I thought you assassins only used daggers?"
Though I didn’t expect the reply, it came.
"Don’t get cocky; you are just a useless hero."

Everyone paused and looked toward the person who is the bronze assassin, while my knights looked at him with anger, as he disrespected their master, but the other bronze assassin gave him a glare because he was the one who made the sound, and now everyone is alerted.
As he was stared at by so many eyes, he stopped his mouth that was about to open again and looked ahead because the knights had already taken their step.

Somewhere far, in the forest center, a few silver-strength beasts awakened from their sleep because the beasts were running back inside, while a heavy aura was already unleashed on the outside, which was on the human road.
Then each of them shook their head, because provoking those humans unnecessarily is not a good thing, and they have suffered more than once.
That’s why they return back to their sleep, though if they came toward their territory, then it would be a different matter.
I charged straight at the silver assassin as my body shadow rippled, and then it became three.
BANG.
Four voidfangs clashed heavily with his silver sword, but he didn’t even budge from his place.
Though surrounding trees were shaken violently, as the shockwave spread, the knights and bronze assassin also made a distance from us.
CLANG CLANG.
I didn’t stop, but I continued to exchange more and more strikes with him along with my doppelganger, but he took all four of our attacks relaxedly.
Meanwhile,

In the distance, fifteen knights clashed heavily with the bronze assassins, even though they are good at sneak attacks and weak in frontal battle, but because of their peak realm, they were able to handle it somewhat.
BANG.
Though the owl hybrid man was strong, as two peak bronze assassins were fighting him and he was still able to fight without losing his ground.
"Shadow blade."
From the side, a low voice comes, and a short black Aether blade launches toward the one assassin who was fighting the hybrid man.
"Carefull"
Other assassins shouted, and the first assassin finally saw a faint black blade that was almost hidden with the night itself was coming straight toward his head.
Clang!
He parried the shadow blade with his dagger toward the other side.
Boom!
The tree exploded the moment Shadow Blade collided with it, and some assassins turned to look toward the source but then returned their attention toward the knights.
The assassin didn’t stop after parrying; instead, he counterattacked as he launched a bronze throwing dagger toward the attacker.
Whoosh.

"Fast!" Aurielle who have attacked him sneakily now suddenly felt the wind move so fast and heard a sound of air cutting, but it was too late to dodge, so she used her shadow step ability to instantly teleport behind the tree.
Thud, thud.
The moment she appeared behind the tree, she heard two sounds of daggers being stuck at ground, where she was a moment earlier.
"Bastard," she cursed, because she can’t use her night veil skill, as everyone will become blind, and she can’t handle all the bronze knights by herself.

"Should I use my ultimate ability?" This thought just came into her mind and next moment she shook her head instantly because Abyssal Execution is strong, but she can use that ability only once, and then she will be knocked out or, worse, heavily injured.
Aurielle gritted her teeth as she looked toward the knights who keep getting injured, then toward the owl hybrid man.

"His Origin ability is good, but how long can he remain in that form?" Aurielle muttered while watching him, but the next moment she noticed that Luke was not able to do any damage toward the silver knight as well.
She got worried but still didn’t intervene in their fights.
"I have to kill these assassins first." She finally hardened her resolve, as this is the only fastest way.
She took a deep breath, as she was finally going to use her dominion ability, which she had worked on for many years.
"Even though allies will get affected, at least I will also become stronger."
As her final words finished, she raised her sword high with both hands and brought it down and planted her purple sword into the ground, and then she uttered the name that suited this ability most.
"Night Dominion"
BOOOOOOM!
Darkness erupts outward.
And the night sky becomes completely black.
A giant circular field suddenly expands around her.
"What’s happening?"
One by one, everyone got an envelope in this dark field as they cried out in alarm, while the knight also gave a wary look, but they were also unable to do anything.
Some assassin saw this from the distance and tried to move far away, but it spread very fast, and soon everyone got inside it.
Luke and Silver, the assassins, were the only ones not to get trapped, as they were far, but both of them did turn and look toward the darkness sphere, which covers nearly a 250 m radius.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Owl’s Final Screech
paragraphs: "Where are we?" the bronze assassins muttered in panic as they felt something was watching them, but they couldn’t find who.
While knights also gathered together with the owl hybrid man and looked warily at the surroundings for potential attacks.
Aurielle watched all this from the distance calmly, then thought about her ability.
Night Dominion
Creates a localised darkness field.
Inside the field:
• Aurielle becomes stronger.
• Enemies experience reduced perception.
• Shadow abilities become more powerful.
Then she activated her origin skill as well, "Shadow Sovereign", which grants her more control over shadows and, along with it, its passive effects, which buff her shadow attacks.
WHOSHHH.

One assassin was looking around warily with his dagger pointed out with full concentration, but the next moment he heard a very low sound of air ripping and turned towards it, but then his eyes got wide as a shadow blade suddenly came from behind him and was now heading straight towards his heart, while some shadows were tightly clinging to his body, and he was not able to move even his arm.
"Help!" Seeing the situation was urgent, he shouted hastily, whereupon surrounding assassins turned towards his position, and one even threw his dagger, but -
PUCHI!
"Ugh..." but before he could intercept it, the shadow blade pierced his heart, and a painful grunt escaped his mouth while blood started coming out.
With his widened eyes, he got dropped to the ground with a thud while his face was facing one direction.
A pair of beautiful purple eyes was also gazing back at him.
But he can’t move, and finally, with lots of regrets, the light in his eyes snaps out.
"What happened?"
"Did you see anything?"
Every assassin got afraid, as they felt nothing, and now one of them is dead and lying on the ground as the pool of blood collects around them.
But they failed to notice one thing: that there is not only one enemy here.
"There, attack!"
The hybrid owl man heard their loud voices and charged towards them with other knights.
"Shit!"

Other assassins, cursed as they saw more enemies are coming, then they got in position to face them, but all of them are still wary of the hidden person, who somehow was able to take down one of their own.
CLANG CLANG CLANG.
Soon both knights and assassins faced each other as their weapons collided.
BANG.
The hybrid man was able to injure one assassin in the second exchange, as he was not fully concentrated in the fight.
"Damn it."
He cursed as he felt his stomach having now a deep wound of claw, and then he saw that owl man was about to get stabbed; he shielded himself with his wings.
Thud, thud.
Two assassins attacked his strong feathers; the result was not effective, as they felt they had hit the leather armour.
But suddenly, one of the assassins got his ankle trapped by a shadow tightly clinging to it.
"What?"
He panicked, but with his force, he broke apart and looked warily around; fortunately, this gives the owl man some time to make distance and get some breath.
In the distance Aurielle watched all this and sighed.
"I used too much energy in the last attack."
She shook her head, as these dominion skills she was only able to cast because of her sword, but even with it, she couldn’t use it fully yet.
CLINK.
Then she heard the sound of a chain rattling, but in the next moment a bronze chain made of some strong alloy bound her neck suddenly.
"This is bad," she muttered as she felt a strong force pulling her towards a bronze assassin in the distance.
"Got you," he said with a big smile as he was finally able to find her.
Aurielle tried to break this chain with her hands and with shadows as well but wasn’t able to damage it enough to break it.

"Shadow Step" She finally used her movement skill, but the next moment her expression fell because she found that these chains attached to her were blocking the flow of aether to be channelled through her body properly.
"Do you really think we don’t know about your ability?"
The assassin laughed at her futile attempt from the distance, as he is the same assassin who made the sound earlier and also mocked Luke back.

The other assassins got happy after seeing her get captured and other knights, which now have been reduced to only ten, because Aurielle has transported those who were seriously injured to a far distance.
They were trying to rescue her, but assassins, though injured and tired after fighting so long, were still able to control them.
SCREECH!
But then everyone heard a loud bird screech and looked towards it; there the owl hybrid man’s stomach got pierced and his one wing tore apart, but...
"What the hell!"
One assassin shouted after seeing that the owl man’s one hand had pierced the heart of one assassin while his bird beak had bitten hard into the neck of one assassin.
The assassin with a pained expression looked hopefully towards the other assassin for their help.
But the next moment...
RIPPED!
A ripping sound echoed as Owlman had ripped the assassin’s head from his body with his beak.
SCREECH!
He screeched again and looked towards everyone with a bloodied hand and bloodied face.
"Monster", one assassin muttered as he moved back weakly; on this, some assassins also look warily towards the owl man.
Though, fortunately, he also got injured, as he was bleeding heavily from his gut, as the dagger had cut his internal organs.
"Focus on her, everyone," the assassin shouted to everyone, on which they also returned to their senses, and soon four other assassins also summoned their chains and binds towards the Aurielle body.
"Ughh..." Aurielle groans in pain, as now both her hands and legs are bound, while a chain is wrapped around her neck.
"Protect the baroness!"
The owl man shouted towards other knights, but sadly one assassin also threw one chain towards him and bound his neck.
He looked at the assassins with bloodshot eyes, like he wanted to kill all of them.
"Foolish, you touched something which you should not," he roared while the chain tightened around his neck and said to every assassin.
Other assassins get confused, then understanding comes into their minds.
"Are you talking about her?" The same assassin comes close to Aurielle and holds her head high as he pulls her black hair tightly.
"Bastard!" Owlman roared and struggled more fiercely as the blood started coming out from his neck area.
Other knights also struggled fiercely, as many got stabbed in their bodies.
Soon the night dominion ability slowly starts disappearing.
The owl man looked at his master’s wife, who is now in pain, and that bastard who is clutching her hair with a smile.
"MASTER!"
[Chapter End]

The other assassins got happy after seeing her get captured and other knights, which now have been reduced to only ten, because Aurielle has transported those who were seriously injured to a far distance.
They were trying to rescue her, but assassins, though injured and tired after fighting so long, were still able to control them.
SCREECH!
But then everyone heard a loud bird screech and looked towards it; there the owl hybrid man’s stomach got pierced and his one wing tore apart, but...
"What the hell!"
One assassin shouted after seeing that the owl man’s one hand had pierced the heart of one assassin while his bird beak had bitten hard into the neck of one assassin.
The assassin with a pained expression looked hopefully towards the other assassin for their help.
But the next moment...
RIPPED!
A ripping sound echoed as Owlman had ripped the assassin’s head from his body with his beak.
SCREECH!
He screeched again and looked towards everyone with a bloodied hand and bloodied face.
"Monster", one assassin muttered as he moved back weakly; on this, some assassins also look warily towards the owl man.
Though, fortunately, he also got injured, as he was bleeding heavily from his gut, as the dagger had cut his internal organs.
"Focus on her, everyone," the assassin shouted to everyone, on which they also returned to their senses, and soon four other assassins also summoned their chains and binds towards the Aurielle body.
"Ughh..." Aurielle groans in pain, as now both her hands and legs are bound, while a chain is wrapped around her neck.
"Protect the baroness!"
The owl man shouted towards other knights, but sadly one assassin also threw one chain towards him and bound his neck.
He looked at the assassins with bloodshot eyes, like he wanted to kill all of them.
"Foolish, you touched something which you should not," he roared while the chain tightened around his neck and said to every assassin.
Other assassins get confused, then understanding comes into their minds.
"Are you talking about her?" The same assassin comes close to Aurielle and holds her head high as he pulls her black hair tightly.
"Bastard!" Owlman roared and struggled more fiercely as the blood started coming out from his neck area.
Other knights also struggled fiercely, as many got stabbed in their bodies.
Soon the night dominion ability slowly starts disappearing.
The owl man looked at his master’s wife, who is now in pain, and that bastard who is clutching her hair with a smile.
"MASTER!"
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Crossed the Line
paragraphs: After seeing that the darkness sphere is not expanding anymore, I focused all my attention to the silver assassin and attacked again with my three clone, but he just sidestepped and dodged easily.
After that, he paused slightly for a moment and then shook his head.
"It’s futile, talentless hero."
I heard his mocking voice; after that, his sword starts glowing as he releases a powerful attack that aims straight at my heart.
"Danger, too fast, can’t dodge"—one thought after another instantly comes into my mind, so I instantly use Void Step to move ten meters behind him.
BOOM!
As I teleported, an explosion occurred as the ground exploded and was destroyed where I was a moment earlier.
THUD THUD THUD.
My three doppelgangers also got blasted away from the shockwave and crashed heavily on the nearby tree, and some even crashed to the ground.
"What the hell!"
I cursed after seeing what his attack has done.
"Fortunately, Void Step now can teleport me ten meters, or else I will be doomed."
I sighed in relief, because as my realm became Iron Knight, the Void step 1 m distance became 10 m, which is very beneficial for me.
The silver assassin paused slightly after finding that his attack had missed.
"Interesting"
He muttered while turning towards me, then he asked.
"Was it with this power you killed Darius Ashenford and his soldiers?"
My expression changed on the mention of Ashenford, and I asked. "So it’s really the Ashenford family?"
The silver assassin just shrugged and didn’t answer; instead, he continued his own talk.
"Even though your ability is quite amazing and this giant form is also good, but—"

He paused on this, then turned to look at the three doppelgangers that were blasted apart but were now slowly standing back on their feet and again starting to surround him. He also noticed that some black energy was leaking from their bodies, but it was also stopping slowly.
His gaze then returned back to me as he continued with a boring voice.
"This strength is not enough to kill a peak silver knight."
I also didn’t stop him but waited to restore some of my aether and stamina as well.
The silver assassin also saw this, but he continued his talk.
"Body temper, iron knight, and bronze knight are all good, but silver knight is the first major breakthrough, which changes everything you know about strength."
He paused for a breath, then said, "A real silver knight can fight hundreds of bronze knights."
"What!!!" My pupils dilated as I heard this word; this is absurd. Because a single person’s stamina and Aether are limited.
The silver assassin smiled at this reaction and said in a normal tone.
"I will show you why."
Then he muttered something in a very low voice, which even I can’t hear properly.
"Combat Art"
Then he raised his sword slightly but slowly, on which I felt goosebumps, but before I could use Void Step to dodge, another word escaped his lips.
"Quick Cut"
The next moment, in an instant, which my mind can’t comprehend, he moved slightly, then stopped the next moment as he lowered his sword, but—
His sword is stained with dark blue blood.
"Dark blue?" I muttered unconsciously, then thought, "Doesn’t my blood also become of this color in Nyx’s titan form?"

Then I felt a deep pain in my heart as my origin was damaged and looked sideways; there, my three doppelganger heads dropped to the ground with a thud. After that, they broke into small dark energy particles, along with the dropped heads, and disappeared.
"What? How?" Only this thought comes into my mind, but before I can understand all of this, I feel something missing as my right side feels lighter than usual.

I got confused, but still slowly I turned my head to the right side, and the next moment, my pupils widened because my right... my right hand, along with Voidfang, was gone. Then the next second I heard the silver assassin’s playful voice.
"Are you looking for this?"
I instantly turn toward him, and there he is, holding a giant bloody hand with a sword still clutched in that hold.
Then I also noticed his boot is releasing heat, and the ground beneath his foot seems a little bit burned.
"So he moves so fast that I can’t perceive him."
This thought occured to me, but the next second—
"AHHHHHHHHHHH!"

Luke’s pained scream echoed as his hand was cut so fast and so cleanly that even his body failed to react to the absence of his right hand and the wound; even his blood didn’t come out because his Aether was stuck in place and stopped the blood flow.
But now it did, and he felt the unbreakable pain.
"Ahh...
"It hurts!"
Luke’s eyes got teary, as this is the first time he felt so much pain, because in his last life, he was an ordinary guy, and even after being transported to this world, he didn’t feel this much pain.
The silver assassin looked amusedly at Luke’s behavior, whose tears came out just from the absence of a single hand.
"Well, you can’t compare to us," he thought and then said to Luke.
"Well, the client asked me to torture you and find out where Darius and Roland Ashendford are... before slowly killing you."
He paused slightly after this as he looked at Luke’s face, who was gritting his teeth to bear pain, but then added another line.
"So don’t blame me; blame them."
With that, he shrugged, like he was not the one who had done this.
I gritted my teeth in pain as I felt pain coming, because my right hand was missing and pain was coming from the heart area as well because of the loss of clone.
But fortunately, my titan healing kicked in, and slowly blood stopped flowing out from my wound as it finally, but slowly, closed.
"Huff...hufff."
I took a forced breath to calm down my body, and all this time the assassin didn’t intervene. "It seems like he is really planning to torture me."
This thought instantly comes into my mind, and then I check the status of the missing hand, but the result is bad because if I want to grow my back arm, it will take at least 1 day in giant form.
Then the next moment, I heard a shout that was a mixture of both a bird and a man. At this, both Silver the assassin and I turned to look toward the source.
"MASTER!"
There in the distance, the night curtains slowly disappear, and appear the group of assassins and knights, who were both injured.

There, the Owl hybrid man, who was bound by a chain to his neck, as two assassins were tightly holding him down, and then the knights, who were injured and were groaning in pain on the other side, as their bodies lay on the ground.
But the next moment my mind goes blank because I see Aurielle is tightly bound by five chains and a person is holding her hair to lift her head up like a trophy...
I can see her face, as she was in agony while blood coming down from her neck.
Then without even my thinking, a word escaped my mouth.
"YOU CROSSED THE LINE."
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 40: The Name That Should Never Be Spoken
paragraphs: In the Blackstone Highlands, Aurora was eating a lavish meal inside the mansion while Elena and other mages were also eating beside her, as everyone had gathered together to eat in the dining hall today.
Maids remained standing at the side with heads bowed, while the clatter of knives and spoons was the only sound that echoed through the room.
But then-
"Huh?" Aurora mid-stopped her eating as she felt a sharp pain in her chest.
"Miss?" one of the maids noticed this and asked her. But instead of replying, Aurora suddenly stood up because she felt the master was very angry.
CLINK.

Her spoon dropped on the ground as that sound echoed inside the room, and this made maid so afraid that they backed away because suddenly Aurora’s face changed, and she also released, somewhat, her silver-rank aura.
Elena, who was eating beside her, also felt her aura and stopped eating; then she saw Aurora’s expression was not very good.
"What happened, Aurora?" Elena stood up and placed a hand on her shoulder as she asked.
Aurora snapped out of her thoughts, but she still felt the pain in her chest.
"I don’t know; I just felt that Master was very angry."
As she finished her words, all the people present got stunned.
"Master is angry?"
"Lord is angry?"
The maid knows that Aurora and the mages called the lord, their master, so this word escaped their mouths.
"Yeah," Aurora nodded her head and looked worriedly toward the direction where her master had left.
Elena also felt worried, but she still told everyone to calm down and then hugged the Aurora while saying it.
"Don’t worry, Aurora; Master is very strong; he will be ok..."
But Elena’s heart also becomes unsettled.
Aurora heard Elena’s voice, but her tension didn’t decreased even a little bit.
"Master, why didn’t you take me?"
Even in a hugged state, she only said this in a low voice, as her eyes still looked toward her master’s departed direction.
"Ugh... my hand."
I cried in pain while clutching my right shoulder; even though blood had stopped flowing, that area still hurt.
[Luke, you can use your second titan form, but remember, at your first stage, Iron Knight, you can only maintain titan form for just one minute.]
I nodded as the system explained about the second form, as using it at the start was risky because I didn’t know if I could take him down in one minute.
Then the system continued.
[And remember to first summon your titan form, then only summon your second form armor, or else even I don’t know how you can handle that armor without your titan.]
My face started to change then it became worried after I heard the system say some weird words.
[Whatever, show him Luke that no one can beat you, not in combat and not even in bed~]
I felt motivated as I heard the system words, but my hand nearly slipped from my shoulder on its last word.
"He is never going to behave normally."
I thought this, while the silver assassin, keeps bubbling some words, to which I don’t care, but—
"MASTER!"
Then a shout entered my ears, which seemed to be calling me, so I looked toward it.

But the next moment, my mind completely went blank because I saw Aurielle’s bloodied figure in the distance and chains wrapped around her tightly and an assassin with a large grin, holding her hair forcefully as he lifted her head violently, on which I could see pain in her face.
Then my eyes met her, on which her face changed to worry as she noticed my severed hand and her eyes become moist, as a tear dropped from her eye.
My heart aches over this, as I have promised myself that I will never let anyone hurt my wife, but I failed again.
And now she is crying.
"Don’t cry, Aurielle; I am here..."
I muttered something in a very low voice as my voice shivered and my eyes also became moist.
Then I uttered a word without even realizing it.
"YOU CROSSED THE LINE."
The silver assassin titled his head as he also observed all of this scene, but he didn’t get scared because of some baseless threat given by a dying hero.
But he still didn’t move, as maybe this will help him to get the answer, so he just keeps watching.
I didn’t care for the silver assassin’s expression.
Then I said those words, which were never meant to be spoken in this universe.
*"That which possesses no identity..."*
Somewhere far, where time itself has lost its meaning, stood twelve colossal titans whose size dwarfed the galaxies.
RUMBLEEEEEEEE!
A being who was sleeping for so long that even reality doesn’t know finally awoke and opened its eyes.
"Eyes!!!"
Reality glitched for a moment because even it can’t understand. How does it know? that it has eyes, while it can only see a white faceless face.
"Ah... don’t worry about little details."
Finally, reality spoke those words, because that being doesn’t have a mouth, and that’s why reality said those words, because that being wants to do it.
"So confusing!"
Reality glitches again, as it can’t understand what is happening.
"So you are the one who awoken me?"
The faceless titan is wrapped in so many chains from neck to toe, which can’t be counted, because their numbers seem infinite.
While other titan who is still sleeping have only few to dozens chains around them.
The faceless titan didn’t mind, as it didn’t get the reply of the being who awakened it, but then it heard an ancient voice.
*"That which possesses no form..."*
It paused slightly on this, and then for a moment its face changed. No, it’s changed again... again...
But the next instant as it’s changed, it’s returned back to the same faceless, white face.
Reality got so much more confused because of this, as it’s not able to understand anything.
While the System watched all of this silently, he even saw all the faces that the faceless being changed, but he can’t describe that in numbers; if he did, then this reality would be destroyed.
"Interesting"
Reality spoke the words that the faceless being said as it looked toward the place and saw a black-haired human who was holding his severed shoulder.
Like those chains seals are not stopping its power at all.
*"That which walks the Unknown Path..."*
Finally, reality glitched so hard, because it... it remembered it was this being that was—
"Sshhhhhhhh"
Reality speaks those words, as that faceless being makes it.
"Awaken, Myrkhal Titan."
"Well, that word you should not have spoken."
Reality was struggling already, but when that name was mentioned, it nearly went blank, but then it heard the real voice of that faceless being, which finally broke the camel’s back.
SHATTERRRRRR!.
The whole reaility shatter with a huge sound, as only Oblivion remains. but-
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Warden of the Unknown Path
paragraphs: But-
The faceless being looks around and finds that its brothers and sisters are still completely fine, like even realities can’t erase them.
"Well, time to see the new world."
With that word, all the chains that were wrapping it around suddenly wriggle, then start entering its body like snakes.
WHOSSSHHH.
Then he ripped apart the void and entered.

The silver assassin heard all the words clearly, though those don’t make any sense. Other assassins and knights were also stopped because they found that they wanted to see what would happen, and then Luke finally finished his last word.
"Awaken, Myrkhal Titan."
But the next moment Silver Assassin’s face instantly became pale as he heard the last word and felt something primal, which resides always there inside a being: the fear of the unknown.
But nothing happens even after Luke gets finished, and everything becomes strangely quiet.
[Myrkhal Titan — Warden of the Unknown Path]
[Synchronization Established]
[Unknown Authority Detected]
[Titan Form Activated]
Then—
Everyone watched with horror at Luke.
Because-
His black armour disintegrates into particles and disappears.
Then his skin begins losing colour as his dark blue hair falls apart into white dust.
His entire body slowly turns pure white while his face begins to smooth over.
Then his eyes disappear, then his nose disappears, and finally his mouth also disappears.
Every feature was getting erased from his body one by one as his clothes also disappeared as though existence itself were removing them.
All of this happened silently, without any explosion and lightning, like even reality can’t understand this transformation.
When it finally ends—
A twelve-foot white giant stands there silently, and his face is featureless, expressionless, and unknown.
The silver assassin took a step back, warily, but he didn’t attack yet because his instinct was screaming at him.
"The moment he does, he will die."

After the transformation was complete, I looked around, even though I felt I didn’t have eyes and a mouth, but I could still see clearly and could also speak; it’s just that it will be a reality voice that will be speaking on my behalf.
"It’s weird."
I thought, while looking at my hand which is smoothly white, then clenched my fist and looked sideways at the system screen.
🔹 FORM 3 — TITAN ASCENSION (Activated)
✔ Body enlargement (2x)
✔ Strength ×5 burst (temporary)
✔ Pressure aura intimidation (Error)
✔ High stamina drain

[Form Transformation]
The authority of the Faceless Titan.
A power born from a lineage that abandoned its original identity and became Endless Forms.
Through this ability, the user may assume the shape of any unlocked Titan Face and inherit its abilities.
Every transformation grants a different body.
Everybody grants a different power.
For the Faceless Titan possesses no true face of its own.

Unlocked

I spread my hand while continuing.
*"Take shape once more..."*
Everyone clearly heard the words and prepared themselves for the inevitable.

Because the white particles start gathering from every direction and attach to Luke’s body.

No metallic sounds are produced.
No armour pieces attach themselves.

Its smooth surface resembles a flawless shell sculpted from an unknown substance.
Unlike ordinary armour, Nullex appears less like equipment and more like a second skin grown directly over the body.
The armour possessed no fixed design because they felt the more they observed, the more confused they became.
Some saw knight armour, some saw mage robes, and some even saw the rock armour.

Then it’s dawn to them; they have forgotten the appearance of Nullex.

His voice shudders, as he can’t describe this abomination.

It exists as an anomaly even among the ancient Titan regalias.

Myrkhal Titan

*"Death can be understood."*

Armour Ability
Nullex possesses no fixed form.
As the Regalia of the Unknown Path, Nullex continuously adapts itself to the wearer’s circumstances.
When faced with danger, the armour instinctively manifests the most suitable offensive or defensive adaptation.
These manifestations occur without conscious control and are never completely identical.
Even the wearer cannot accurately predict how Nullex will respond.

• Adaptive Offence

🔹 FORM 2 — TITAN ARMOUR MODE (Activated)
✔ Armour manifestation
✔ Weapon summon (Error)
✔ Strength × 3 burst
"Good," I muttered.
But the next moment, my pupils narrowed as I looked towards the assassin holding Aurielle by the hair.
The smile on his face had vanished.
The instant his eyes met mine, he instinctively released her and took several steps back in fear.
Then I took a step forward.
At that moment, every assassin instinctively stepped back. Even the silver assassin retreated slightly.
In contrast, all of my knights looked at me with expectant eyes.
Aurielle’s gaze was fixed on me as well, relief clearly visible in her expression, because the severed arm I had lost earlier had completely regrown after I transformed into the Faceless Titan.
"System, which titan can I transform into? Which will give me insane speed?"
I asked the system, as there were many titans already unlocked to use with faceless titans.
[Luke, use Voltrax Titan, Warden of the Storm Path.]
I nodded. Then I took another step while a word escaped into reality.
"Voltrax."
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Warden of the Storm Path
paragraphs: "Voltrax."
The next moment, everyone saw the Faceless Titan’s blank face begin to distort.
Its smooth white surface cracked apart as though something beneath it was forcing its way out.
Jagged horn-like protrusions emerged from the sides and back of its head.
Blue lightning instantly erupted between them.
The featureless face vanished.
In its place appeared a face carved from dark storm-forged metal.
Two blazing blue-white eyes opened.
CRACKKKK!
Arcs of lightning exploded from its body as the transformation rapidly spread downward.
The white body of the Faceless Titan shattered apart like a discarded shell.
In its place stood a fifteen-foot giant.
Dark metallic armour-like skin covered his body.
Six jagged thunder spines rose from his back.
Rivers of lightning flowed through countless glowing channels across his frame.
Every breath released sparks.
Every movement caused thunder to rumble.
The Thunder Titan had arrived.
"What the hell is this?"
One assassin muttered with a horrified expression, as everyone also thought the same.
When they finally thought it was over, then Luke’s armour began to change as well.
The smooth white surface of Nullex cracked apart.
Blue lightning surged through countless fractures spreading across the armour.
The pristine white shell rapidly darkened into a deep storm-metal colour.
New plates emerged around Luke’s shoulders, chest, and forearms.
Jagged lightning-shaped patterns spread throughout the armour as glowing blue currents flowed beneath its surface.
Several thunder-spines rose from Luke’s back, connecting directly to the horn-like conductors growing from Luke’s head.
Arcs of lightning constantly danced between them.
Within seconds, Nullex had completely transformed.
The Faceless Regalia was gone.
In its place stood a suit of living thunder armour.
As the transformation completed, I checked myself a little and got surprised. "So, this is the power of unknown manifestation, because I can feel that using the lightning ability will now be easier."
After that I took a step and disappeared.
BOMMM!
The ground exploded where I was before because my body moved so fast, almost comparable to the speed of lightning.
"What-"
The other assassin didn’t get a chance to finish their sentences, as a blue sickle crackling with thunder has cut down everyone’s heads except the assassin who is near Aurielle.
"This is good."
I muttered as I observed the new thunder sickle, which Nullex created during a mid-sprint.
"How?"
The silver assassin in the distance got confused, even though he is not helpless like other people because he can at least see the blur, but still.
"How can he gain that much power?"
"Because of this power, did he kill Darius Ashenford?"

The silver assassin got confused and then shook his head. "No, it’s not enough. On the Silver Knight stage, one can learn combat arts, which make them comparable to Origin skill users, even though on a lower level."

The more he thought, the more he became confused; then he saw the giant thunder titan cut off both the hands of the bronze assassin who touched Aurielle earlier and threw him to the side like discarded waste.
Then he turned towards me, and our eyes met.
And the next instant he instantly appeared in front of me with lightning speed.
"Quick cut"

The silver assassin hastily summoned his Aether to coat his body and used his combat art instantly, but then something amazing happened, as his sword was about to meet with the thunder titan’s sickle, an elongated blade extended from the edge of the sickle, and it deflected the trajectory of the sword, which made his pupils so large because he knew he messed up, while Sickle still followed the path and with one swift motion cut through the silver Aether-coated hand.
BOOM!
As his sword missed and hit the ground, it exploded the terrain, but he didn’t cry in pain even as his hand was cut the next moment.
Crackle.
But the place where the sickle cut his hand, a small lightning bolt appeared, and then it spread to his whole body, as if it were lightning running on his body and wrapping him.
"Ughh."
The silver assassin grunted in pain, On which I didn’t pause even for a second, as one minute timer was still running, so I attacked him again, but suddenly my weapon changed to a spear.
"Nullex is in a playful mood."
I thought while hastily changing my motion from slashing to piercing.
The assassin’s eyes widened because he didn’t expect his body to be paralysed by the earlier attack, or he would have atleast dodged.
But it’s too late, and there is no medicine for regret.
BOOOM!

The thunder spear pierced through most of his stomach due to its enormous size. Then Luke channelled lightning into the spear, causing violent arcs of electricity to surge through the assassin’s body as it began disintegrating his remaining flesh and bones.
Finally, after a moment, he turns into ash along with his sword, and only a spatial ring is left in its place.
I check the timer, as there are still 10s left in the one-minute duration, but I still return back to my normal form.
As my Nullex also disappeared into white particles.
Then I picked up the spatial ring and summoned some clothes to cover myself before checking its contents.
"No money. Only a note and a few items that seem to be poison."
I shook my head in disappointment before storing everything inside it and placed it on my index ring.
The whole battlefield becomes silent, as the assassins are already dead and the knights don’t dare to say anything without their master’s order.

While the assassin whose hands were cut off is also stopped his pained voice because he got too shocked as he saw a first-stage iron knight killing a third-stage silver knight for the very first time.

I turned towards everyone and began walking forward. Even though I could feel exhaustion weighing heavily on my body from the continuous use of my Third Form, I couldn’t bear to see my wife in such a condition.
As I approached Aurielle, I bent down and gently picked her up, having already destroyed all the chains that had bound her.
Aurielle paused slightly on this, and then she asked.
"Are you okay?"
I stopped on this but still held her in a princess carry, and then I looked at her beautiful face, even though her face got some dirt, but I didn’t care.
"Yes."
I smiled at her and gently kissed her forehead. After hearing my words, she finally closed her eyes and fell asleep, no longer able to resist the exhaustion weighing on her body.
I smiled seeing that she finally relaxed, and then I turned around, and my expression turned cold.
There, the bronze assassin was still lying quietly without his hand and was looking down because he didn’t want to face that monster.
Then I looked towards other knights; even though some are heavily injured, none of them are dead.
"Bind him behind the horses with ropes and drag him."
I spoke to everyone. Upon hearing my words, the knight with a Spirit Owl standing behind him stepped forward. Placing a fist against his chest, he bowed respectfully and said,
"Yes, Master."
The Bronze assassin’s expression turned ugly when he heard those words, but he remained lying quietly on the ground.
I nodded slightly and thought,
"It seems his transformation is something special."
[Chapter End.]

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 100x Multiplier: S-Rank Reward.
paragraphs: "It seems his transformation is something special."
Then I said the last word to everyone before going toward camp, as Margaret was still hiding there.
"Do the first aid for now; when we reach the count’s territory, there all of you will get proper treatment."
"YES, MASTER!"
All of them said in a loud voice; even some who were lying on the ground shouted while looking toward me with unwavering faith.

I sighed seeing this and thought we definitely needed high grade potions, but sadly territory potions made by alchemists are not effective on iron knights, and those merchants also didn’t bring any good health potions to our territory.
Then finally, after a moment, I reached the campsite and looked around and then spoke in a normal voice.
"Margaret, come out."

Margaret, who was still hiding, suddenly trembled when she heard the footstep because she didn’t know what was happening at the battlefield, but when she finally heard her lord’s voice, her face instantly became bright, and she came out happily.
But when she saw the lady Aurielle was in Lord Hands’s as she was bleeding and wounded, her expression turned to worry, and she hurriedly ran towards them.
"What happened to the lady, my lord?"
I heard Margaret’s worried voice as she asked me with a concerned face.
I shook my head and said it.
"She is only exhausted, but still, provide her with first aid. Let her drink one of the health potions we have, clean her wounds, and help her change into fresh clothes as well."
Margaret sighed in relief when she heard the lady was just exhausted but then nodded after hearing her lord’s order and took the Aurielle from his hand to hers, though.
"Ahhh."
Aurielle’s one hand is still tightly holding Luke’s clothes even after she got to sleep.
A smile appeared on my face as Margaret also smiled and teased me.
"It seems like the lady doesn’t want to separate from her husband even for a second."
I didn’t reply to her, but my smile widened slightly. Then I gently removed her hand and watched as Margaret escorted her back to her camp.
"Ahhh, finally this long night will be over."
I sighed as I stretched my body and looked toward the sky; there, moonlight shone on my face, but then I thought about those assassins, and my expression became cold.
"Your organization that took mission on me and my wife and the Ashenford family."
I paused before narrowing my eyes.
"I will erase your existence from this world."

I finally completed my vow, then left to sleep in my tent, while some knights patrolled the area and looked toward the tightly bound prisoner as well, who was temporarily receiving first aid to stop his bleeding.
"Is he awake now?"
"I don’t know."
"Ahh," I opened my eyes slowly, not because of morning birds chirping but because of some gossiping words.
As I sit up while rubbing my eyes, I see two tiny figures are floating beside me.

"Huh?" I muttered in confusion, wondering if I was hallucinating because I hadn’t gotten enough sleep. So I rubbed my eyes and looked again, but they were still there. In fact, they were now staring at me as if I were an idiot.
"Should I sleep again? Maybe after I wake up for real, this dream will be over."
I thought while moving towards my pillow again, but then I heard their voices.
"Wake up, kid, it’s already morning."
I stopped mid action because they are real; I can see their expressions and can hear their voices.
"Nyx? Myrkhal?"
I muttered, because those two small figures, the size of fairies, are the same titan whom I have transformed before.
"Yes"
Myrkhal said with a smile because a blue mouth has appeared on his face, though all other organs are still missing.
"But how?" I asked in shock. In response, they simply shrugged.
"We also don’t know."
Nyx then told him that he had been trapped inside that zone when he heard someone calling his name.
"And now I am here, in this tiny form, a spirit."
Myrkhal also nodded slightly from the side, but he still had a smile on his face.
"The whole situation is weird," I thought, then asked the system about what is happening.
[Well, Luke, when you unlock your titan form, you have also shattered their binding, and now they have merged with you.]
The system paused for a moment to let me digest the information and then continued.
[And the tiny figures you are seeing are the actual Titans. It’s just that their powers have also been erased, and they are now in the same realm as you.]
I understand something, like the merging, and that’s why they have lost their power. but-

"What about their tiny figure?" I looked back to the system while giving a look toward both of them. There, Nyx is looking at me with curiosity, like, who am I talking to? But Myrkhal was moving around the tent with curiosity.
[Well, well, that’s their real form. Normally, they can increase their size, but it seems they can’t do that right now.]
"What the hell?" I literally got stunned. Are those tiny figures the original titans? Aren’t titans known for their large size?.
I took a breath to calm down and told them what the system told me.
"Interesting," Myrkhal muttered from the side as he suddenly appeared behind the Nyx titan, who was stunned after hearing about merging.
I ignored Myrkhal’s curiosity and instead asked about his size. on which both Nyx and Myrkhal again gave me a look of an idiot.
"What?" I was flabbergasted by those looks again. Then they told me the reason.
"We are real titans; only low-blood titans have a fixed large form and—"
Nyx paused slightly and spoke with a disguised voice.
"That’s why their strength depends upon their size, but we pure titans have our full-body form strength even in tiny forms."
"Wow, that’s insane." A loud exclamation escaped from my mouth after hearing this.
Then I talk with them for some time, though only Nyx was listening and answering my question, because Myrkhal has gone outside to look.
"Wait?" Can anyone else see you? I asked Nyx while looking at the departed figure of tiny Myrkhal.
Nyx shook his head. "We have merged with you, and we are just part of you, but at a spiritual level."
He paused as he looked at his hand, which looks almost the same as his titan’s body.
"So no one can see us without our permission; it’s just that we can’t go far from you."
He finally finished his last sentence with a sigh, as he doesn’t like these restrictions.
I nodded at him and checked my system message and the reward from the previous day.
[Congrulations Luke, as you have got an S rank reward after your 100x multiplier.]
[Chapter End]

sentences.text: "It seems his transformation is something special."
Then I said the last word to everyone before going toward camp, as Margaret was still hiding there.
"Do the first aid for now; when we reach the count’s territory, there all of you will get proper treatment."
"YES, MASTER!"
All of them said in a loud voice; even some who were lying on the ground shouted while looking toward me with unwavering faith.

I sighed seeing this and thought we definitely needed high grade potions, but sadly territory potions made by alchemists are not effective on iron knights, and those merchants also didn’t bring any good health potions to our territory.
Then finally, after a moment, I reached the campsite and looked around and then spoke in a normal voice.
"Margaret, come out."

Margaret, who was still hiding, suddenly trembled when she heard the footstep because she didn’t know what was happening at the battlefield, but when she finally heard her lord’s voice, her face instantly became bright, and she came out happily.
But when she saw the lady Aurielle was in Lord Hands’s as she was bleeding and wounded, her expression turned to worry, and she hurriedly ran towards them.
"What happened to the lady, my lord?"
I heard Margaret’s worried voice as she asked me with a concerned face.
I shook my head and said it.
"She is only exhausted, but still, provide her with first aid.
Let her drink one of the health potions we have, clean her wounds, and help her change into fresh clothes as well."
Margaret sighed in relief when she heard the lady was just exhausted but then nodded after hearing her lord’s order and took the Aurielle from his hand to hers, though.
"Ahhh."
Aurielle’s one hand is still tightly holding Luke’s clothes even after she got to sleep.
A smile appeared on my face as Margaret also smiled and teased me.
"It seems like the lady doesn’t want to separate from her husband even for a second."
I didn’t reply to her, but my smile widened slightly.
Then I gently removed her hand and watched as Margaret escorted her back to her camp.
"Ahhh, finally this long night will be over."
I sighed as I stretched my body and looked toward the sky; there, moonlight shone on my face, but then I thought about those assassins, and my expression became cold.
"Your organization that took mission on me and my wife and the Ashenford family."
I paused before narrowing my eyes.
"I will erase your existence from this world."

I finally completed my vow, then left to sleep in my tent, while some knights patrolled the area and looked toward the tightly bound prisoner as well, who was temporarily receiving first aid to stop his bleeding.
"Is he awake now?"
"I don’t know."
"Ahh," I opened my eyes slowly, not because of morning birds chirping but because of some gossiping words.
As I sit up while rubbing my eyes, I see two tiny figures are floating beside me.
"Huh?" I muttered in confusion, wondering if I was hallucinating because I hadn’t gotten enough sleep.
So I rubbed my eyes and looked again, but they were still there.
In fact, they were now staring at me as if I were an idiot.
"Should I sleep again?
Maybe after I wake up for real, this dream will be over."
I thought while moving towards my pillow again, but then I heard their voices.
"Wake up, kid, it’s already morning."
I stopped mid action because they are real; I can see their expressions and can hear their voices.
"Nyx?
Myrkhal?"
I muttered, because those two small figures, the size of fairies, are the same titan whom I have transformed before.
"Yes"
Myrkhal said with a smile because a blue mouth has appeared on his face, though all other organs are still missing.
"But how?" I asked in shock.
In response, they simply shrugged.
"We also don’t know."
Nyx then told him that he had been trapped inside that zone when he heard someone calling his name.
"And now I am here, in this tiny form, a spirit."
Myrkhal also nodded slightly from the side, but he still had a smile on his face.
"The whole situation is weird," I thought, then asked the system about what is happening.
[Well, Luke, when you unlock your titan form, you have also shattered their binding, and now they have merged with you.]
The system paused for a moment to let me digest the information and then continued.
[And the tiny figures you are seeing are the actual Titans.
It’s just that their powers have also been erased, and they are now in the same realm as you.]
I understand something, like the merging, and that’s why they have lost their power. but-
"What about their tiny figure?" I looked back to the system while giving a look toward both of them.
There, Nyx is looking at me with curiosity, like, who am I talking to?
But Myrkhal was moving around the tent with curiosity.
[Well, well, that’s their real form.
Normally, they can increase their size, but it seems they can’t do that right now.]
"What the hell?" I literally got stunned.
Are those tiny figures the original titans?
Aren’t titans known for their large size?.
I took a breath to calm down and told them what the system told me.
"Interesting," Myrkhal muttered from the side as he suddenly appeared behind the Nyx titan, who was stunned after hearing about merging.
I ignored Myrkhal’s curiosity and instead asked about his size. on which both Nyx and Myrkhal again gave me a look of an idiot.
"What?" I was flabbergasted by those looks again.
Then they told me the reason.
"We are real titans; only low-blood titans have a fixed large form and—"
Nyx paused slightly and spoke with a disguised voice.
"That’s why their strength depends upon their size, but we pure titans have our full-body form strength even in tiny forms."

[Congrulations Luke, as you have got an S rank reward after your 100x multiplier.]
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 44: System Rewrites the Titan Rules
paragraphs: Congratulations, Luke, as you have gotten an S rank reward after your 100x multiplier.
"Cool," I muttered, then looked toward the system screen expectantly, upon which the system suddenly brought out a moving wheel machine, and a big red button appeared alongside it.
"Ohh, new method. "Nice." I nodded and pressed it.
CLING CLING CLING.
The system machine made sounds like it was spinning rapidly, as if it were overworking itself. But then I heard Nyx’s curious voice.
"What are you doing?" I paused and turned sideways as he suddenly appeared on my shoulder, and we were now also looking at the system’s moving wheel machine.
"You can see this?" I asked back shocked, because a few moments ago they were not able to see the system messages, but now they can see this.

"Yeah, I can see these big things," Nyx said while pointing toward the machine, on which I asked the system, and it replied, "From now on, they can see all the systems’ screens if they appear in front of them.
"Well, it’s fine," I muttered in a low voice as the wheel machine was finally stopping.
Wow!! Congratulations! Luke, you have got basic restrictions removed from all your forms.
"What?" I asked the system with the confused expression. but Nyx cut it.
"Your form has restrictions, but why?"
As I already told Nyx about my forms, even I don’t know if there was any restriction.
Then Nyx explained that even in ancient times, many people have borrowed their power, but none of them have those basic restrictions.
Finally, System answered this to me and Nyx.
[Well, Luke was mortal when he got the origin skill to summon your forms, so I have put some restrictions and also changed it so he can use that with his mortal body.]
The system paused for a moment for us, at which I nodded, and Nyx just looked thoughtful, like he could already guess where this was going.
[So, like, your first form gives you some titan regeneration, durability, and two times strength.]

[It’s not exactly like that. From now on, the system is reverting to its original structure. Your first form will now inherit partial traits of your third form, allowing you to use some of its abilities in a limited way. However, you will no longer receive additional strength buffs in this form.]
"Crazy," I cursed after hearing this because it was too cool; if I could use Nyx’s void doppelganger skill in my first form, my first form would consume very little stamina.
Then my mood plummeted somewhat when I thought about the loss of those two times strength.
"When there is gain, there is loss as well."
I shook my head, but then my eyes narrowed.
"System, this restriction was set by you. So you’re just releasing it back now? Don’t tell me you’re thinking of swallowing my S rank rewards?"
Nyx, confused, asked, "Was that true?" on this system screen, glitching slightly like he was sweating, and then he said it in a defensive voice.
[Luke, I am an honest system-]
"Horny system"
The system paused as I cut him, but he ignored my word and continued.
[The restriction on your first form was only released as a bonus. Your true reward is this: from now on, you will be able to unlock more of your Titan abilities depending on your realm.]
I stopped and thought for a moment, still confused. Nyx also watched from the side quietly; even though he understood it somewhat, he was still waiting for the system to continue.
[Like in the Body temper realm, your titan has one ability, but now in the Iron realm, you will have a second ability unlocked.]
"WHAT!!!"
I exclaimed loudly about this because this was too broken.
"My lord, what’s happened?"
I calm down a little, as my voice was so loud that my knights suddenly come outside my tent.
"I am fine; just go back and do your duty."
The knights heard their lord’s normal voice, even though they got confused as to why he then screamed, but they still obeyed and left after bowing to him.
"Your soldiers seem to have high respect for you," Nyx said from the side as he watched all this.
I smiled and scratched my head, then turned to check the ability that I have gained first.
"Let’s see, Nyx, what of your abilities I have unlocked this time?"
Nyx also looked expectantly, because he has so many skills and abilities that counting them is going to take too much time.
SECOND ABILITY — NYX TITAN
Null Veil of Nyx
Description
The Nyx Titan dissolves his presence into the Void layer, erasing all traces of existence at physical, spiritual, and energetic levels until he becomes indistinguishable from nothingness itself.
He does not hide.
He becomes absent in the world’s perception of reality.
Core Effects
* Completely conceals physical presence
* Erases aura, mana signature, and life detection.
* Breaks most tracking, sensing, and prediction abilities
* Makes the user "nonexistent" to weaker perception systems.
* Allows movement while undetected within void-shadowed environments
* Can be maintained passively at high control levels
"Wow, insane." After fully reading, I muttered those words. I have heard about these types of hiding skills, but this one is broken.
"Well, you are lucky to summon my racial ability."
Nyx, who is still seated on my shoulder, said with a surprised voice.
"Racial ability?"
I asked back to him confusedly; he nodded and told me.
"As you have already have my Shadow of Nyx, in which you just do not create a clone or shadow."
He paused as he saw my expectant look, wanting to know more, and then a big smile appeared on his face.
"Instead, it brings out a real self of you from the void."
My mind went blank for a moment when I heard the term "real self.
But then he added one more line.
"As void, records everything: past, present, and even future."
As he finished the sentence, his expression became melancholy, like remembering those old days.
"But you are lucky, because it’s mine own ability that I maxed to an extreme level, and that’s what you have got."
I nodded, because I could feel this doppelganger ability was very powerful, and then I asked him about its second ability.

He said that it was the true racial ability of his kind, one in which, unless someone had a detection skill or an ability to sense enemies, he could theoretically become completely invisible. However, this ability consumed a large amount of Aether.
"Good." After saying this, I looked toward my second titan’s second ability.
Titan Ability II
System Description
[Form Assimilation]
The Faceless Titan possesses flesh without a fixed identity.
By invoking the authority of Endless Forms, the user may assimilate a complete trait from another unlocked Titan Face.
Physical traits manifest directly upon the body.
Ability-based traits grant access to the corresponding Titan ability.
Current Effect:
• One Assimilated Trait
Warning:
Excessive assimilation places tremendous strain upon the body.
Possible consequences include the following:
• Muscle tearing
• Bone fractures
• Organ damage
• Titan Instability
Status:
Unlocked

"This is absurd." My mouth fully opened after reading the full description, and then I looked toward the Nyx titan, whose face had also become ugly, because this ability is definitely crazier than his second ability.
"Even though his ability name is not great, the ability itself is crazy."
Nyx muttered, and I nodded, because just thinking about it, if I became a Strength Titan and added the traits of a Defense Titan, wouldn’t that make me invincible in the same realm?
Then I look around, but sadly Myrkhal is not here, so I can’t ask him for more details.
"Master, breakfast is ready."
As I finished my thoughts and closed the system screen, I heard the knight’s voice from outside.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 45: A Lord Under His Lady’s Mercy
paragraphs: "Master, breakfast is ready."
As I finished my thoughts and closed the system screen, I heard the knight’s voice from outside.
"Okay."
After saying that, I stood up and left the tent.
"Ahh, too bright."
But the moment I got outside, I shielded my eyes with my hands, as the sunlight directly met my eyes.
Nyx, though, sits comfortably on the shoulder and doesn’t bother with sunlight at all.
Finally, after a moment of adjusting to this brightness, I lowered my hand and looked around.

Every knight is awake and now doing their work, like some are collecting woods while others are gathering branches for the campsite, and the remaining ones are gathering water from the distant small river.

Then I turned around and saw that bronze assassin, still crippled but having survived the night, but his condition seems very bad, as he looks very thirsty and hungry. I noticed this after seeing him looking towards the campfire food with a longing.
"His tolerance is very low; he seems like a new recruit."
This thought comes into my mind because most assassins are famous for their stubbornness and tolerance.
"My lord here!."
Then Margaret’s voice brought me out of my thoughts. I turned and saw that both Margaret and Aurielle were now sitting beneath the tree’s shade, and food was spread out in front of them.
There Margaret was, waving her hand at me, while Aurielle also looked towards me and gave me a loving smile.
Seeing she is safe and fine, a smile blossoms on my face, but then my eyes twitch a little.
Because besides Margaret, tiny Myrkhal was sitting on one plate of fruits and eating with a smiling mouth.
Nyx facepalmed because he knew Myrkhal was the most carefree titan among them.
I ignored him and reached towards them. After a moment, as I got close to Aurielle, I leant and kissed her on the lips before sitting besides her.
Margaret saw this and turned away her face shily, but then her face became confused.
"Where is the fruit?"
Because she saw the fruit plate was empty and only some leftovers were there.
I heard Margaret’s confused voice from the side but didn’t tell her about the truth, as the culprit now has returned and is sitting on my left shoulder while happily waving his legs.
"Luke, why did you turn to a different giant this time?"
Aurielle from the side, who was leaning against my shoulder as her head rested on my shoulder, asked with a curious voice.
I paused, then turned to look at her, but she was looking at the front, and were enjoying the morning breeze.
A mischievous smile appeared on my lips, so I leant close towards her ear and whispered.
"It seems like the Goddess of Luck fell in love with me; that’s why she gave this giant form as a gift."
Aurielle, who was holding hands with Luke while watching the knights working, got stunned.
Then her eyes narrowed, and she brought her hands towards his balls.
Luke, who was smiling, didn’t know that his future generation was in danger, but soon he found out.
"Ahhhhh...—"
Luke screamed as he felt his balls get pressed suddenly, but then Aurielle’s one hand that was holding his hand shot out and wrapped around his mouth, sealing it completely.
"mphpmp"

Margaret, who was still confused about the missing fruit, suddenly heard her lord’s pained sound, but when she turned, all she saw was that lady was holding him intimately, while her one hand was towards his nether region and one hand was closing his mouth.
And while doing this, Lady Aurielle was smiling as she was looking towards Lord Face.
Margaret’s face got turned red, and she lowered her head while muttering in a very low voice.
"Now they are even doing it openly in the morning."
Luke’s eyes had become moist with the pain, but then he heard Margaret’s low voice, so he tried to ask for help because he could see.
Aurielle was smiling dangerously, and she was not losing her hand; instead, her force was increasing.
As Luke turned his head towards Margaret, she also noticed his gaze and raised her head to look at him.
But then she said something which brought even more tears into Luke eyes.
"Shameless"
With that, Margaret stood up and left us, while Luke also saw some knights turn towards us at his scream, but then they also turned their gaze away.
Nyx and Myrkhal, who are now seated above at a tree branch to view the surroundings more clearly, were also looking at Luke.
"What are they doing?"
Nyx asked Myrkhal, who still has a smiling mouth.
Myrkhal, who was waving his legs as he was watching the suffering of the crippled assassin, paused at Nyx’s voice, then also looked down.
"Seems like a wife and husband thing."
Myrkhal’s slightly manly voice comes this time, and Nyx also remembers that there are some living beings who also have this type of relationship.
But they didn’t know below Luke’s future child was depending on the question that Aurielle asked.
~Darling, what did you say just now?~
Aurielle said while bringing her mouth close to his ear, but her hands didn’t move from his lower position; instead, she lessened the force on his mouth.
Sweat formed around Luke’s forehead as he felt her breath, but her low voice sounded dangerous.
So he gathered his courage and asked.
"Darling, calm down and how about first you remove your hands from below?, because if something happened to those, then what would happen to our future child."
Aurielle didn’t stop; instead, she increased her force a little, which made Luke wince more, and then she asked again.
~Darling, tell the answer first.~
Luke finally felt that the joke was not worth enough compared to his balls, so he made a smiling face that looked even more ugly because of the pain, but he still did that and said it.
"Aurielle, I was just joking."
But after hearing his word, Aurielle instead applied more force, then finally released it with a swift motion.
As she washed her hand after that.
"Huff... huff."
Luke breath becomes rough as the pain slowly subsides, but then he hear her dangerous voice again.
~From now on, call me ’honey’ all the time if you don’t want to lose your balls.~
With that, she gave Luke a glare, like asking if I understand or if she has to use her hand again.
Luke got terrified and instantly nodded and said it in a still-pained voice.
"I understand, honey."
"Good boy."
Aurielle nodded with a small smile, then brought the food plate that Margaret prepared for us.
"Here, say ’ahhh’."
She brings the spoon with food to Luke mouth, which he open without choice and eat.
"My good boy."
Aurielle got happy and pinched his cheek while saying this.
Luke face instantly becomes red because he is a lord, and now he is being treated like that; then what reputation will be left for him in front of his knights?
So he turn his head a little and saw that all the knights have their heads already turned around, which saves him from the shame.
But one face was smiling and laughing at Luke condition.
Yeah, that crippled assassin.

Luke eyes twitch at this, but luckily Kai, the person with the spirit owl, came and started beating the assassin with his legs. Other knights also joined in beating him, but then that 2 metre tall owl also came from the side and gave some powerful legs to him.
"There’s something definitely wrong with these people."
"Here, baby, another bite..."
Aurielle’s voice brought Luke out of his thoughts as he reluctantly opened his mouth to eat.
Finally, after half an hour of torture, Aurielle released him, as everyone was also done with the breakfast and was now packing all the things.
[Chapter End]
