After a moment, as I got close to Aurielle, I leant and kissed her on the lips before sitting besides her.
Margaret saw this and turned away her face shily, but then her face became confused.
"Where is the fruit?"
Because she saw the fruit plate was empty and only some leftovers were there.
I heard Margaret’s confused voice from the side but didn’t tell her about the truth, as the culprit now has returned and is sitting on my left shoulder while happily waving his legs.
"Luke, why did you turn to a different giant this time?"
Aurielle from the side, who was leaning against my shoulder as her head rested on my shoulder, asked with a curious voice.
I paused, then turned to look at her, but she was looking at the front, and were enjoying the morning breeze.
A mischievous smile appeared on my lips, so I leant close towards her ear and whispered.
"It seems like the Goddess of Luck fell in love with me; that’s why she gave this giant form as a gift."
Aurielle, who was holding hands with Luke while watching the knights working, got stunned.
Then her eyes narrowed, and she brought her hands towards his balls.
Luke, who was smiling, didn’t know that his future generation was in danger, but soon he found out.
"Ahhhhh...—"
Luke screamed as he felt his balls get pressed suddenly, but then Aurielle’s one hand that was holding his hand shot out and wrapped around his mouth, sealing it completely.
"mphpmp"

Margaret, who was still confused about the missing fruit, suddenly heard her lord’s pained sound, but when she turned, all she saw was that lady was holding him intimately, while her one hand was towards his nether region and one hand was closing his mouth.
And while doing this, Lady Aurielle was smiling as she was looking towards Lord Face.
Margaret’s face got turned red, and she lowered her head while muttering in a very low voice.
"Now they are even doing it openly in the morning."
Luke’s eyes had become moist with the pain, but then he heard Margaret’s low voice, so he tried to ask for help because he could see.
Aurielle was smiling dangerously, and she was not losing her hand; instead, her force was increasing.
As Luke turned his head towards Margaret, she also noticed his gaze and raised her head to look at him.
But then she said something which brought even more tears into Luke eyes.
"Shameless"
With that, Margaret stood up and left us, while Luke also saw some knights turn towards us at his scream, but then they also turned their gaze away.
Nyx and Myrkhal, who are now seated above at a tree branch to view the surroundings more clearly, were also looking at Luke.
"What are they doing?"
Nyx asked Myrkhal, who still has a smiling mouth.
Myrkhal, who was waving his legs as he was watching the suffering of the crippled assassin, paused at Nyx’s voice, then also looked down.
"Seems like a wife and husband thing."
Myrkhal’s slightly manly voice comes this time, and Nyx also remembers that there are some living beings who also have this type of relationship.
But they didn’t know below Luke’s future child was depending on the question that Aurielle asked.
~Darling, what did you say just now?~
Aurielle said while bringing her mouth close to his ear, but her hands didn’t move from his lower position; instead, she lessened the force on his mouth.
Sweat formed around Luke’s forehead as he felt her breath, but her low voice sounded dangerous.
So he gathered his courage and asked.
"Darling, calm down and how about first you remove your hands from below?, because if something happened to those, then what would happen to our future child."
Aurielle didn’t stop; instead, she increased her force a little, which made Luke wince more, and then she asked again.
~Darling, tell the answer first.~
Luke finally felt that the joke was not worth enough compared to his balls, so he made a smiling face that looked even more ugly because of the pain, but he still did that and said it.
"Aurielle, I was just joking."
But after hearing his word, Aurielle instead applied more force, then finally released it with a swift motion.
As she washed her hand after that.
"Huff... huff."
Luke breath becomes rough as the pain slowly subsides, but then he hear her dangerous voice again.
~From now on, call me ’honey’ all the time if you don’t want to lose your balls.~
With that, she gave Luke a glare, like asking if I understand or if she has to use her hand again.
Luke got terrified and instantly nodded and said it in a still-pained voice.
"I understand, honey."
"Good boy."
Aurielle nodded with a small smile, then brought the food plate that Margaret prepared for us.
"Here, say ’ahhh’."
She brings the spoon with food to Luke mouth, which he open without choice and eat.
"My good boy."
Aurielle got happy and pinched his cheek while saying this.
Luke face instantly becomes red because he is a lord, and now he is being treated like that; then what reputation will be left for him in front of his knights?
So he turn his head a little and saw that all the knights have their heads already turned around, which saves him from the shame.
But one face was smiling and laughing at Luke condition.
Yeah, that crippled assassin.
Luke eyes twitch at this, but luckily Kai, the person with the spirit owl, came and started beating the assassin with his legs.
Other knights also joined in beating him, but then that 2 metre tall owl also came from the side and gave some powerful legs to him.
"There’s something definitely wrong with these people."
"Here, baby, another bite..."
Aurielle’s voice brought Luke out of his thoughts as he reluctantly opened his mouth to eat.
Finally, after half an hour of torture, Aurielle released him, as everyone was also done with the breakfast and was now packing all the things.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 46: A Hero Forged by Tragedy
paragraphs: Finally, after half an hour of torture, Aurielle released me, as everyone was also done with the breakfast and was now packing all the things.
Soon everyone arranged all their things and got ready, so we also mounted the carriages while the knight mounted the horse and bound the assassin to its end with ropes.
Aurielle saw all of this from the carriage window, and her expression turned to anger.
Because she remembers how he humiliated her.
"Honey." My voice brings her out of thoughts, as I hugged her while placing her head on my shoulder for rest.
"Neighhh."
Finally, with a sound of a horse’s cry, we start moving, and the assassin gets dragged as his body got scratches from the obstacles.
But after traveling some distance, I asked Aurielle about Count Territory, Stormveil County.
Aurielle, who was looking outside at the moving scenery, paused, then turned toward me, and after thinking for a moment, she started telling me about the origin of Stormveil County.
"Well, some territories are famous for their location or something special like a product they produce in their territory."
"But Stormveil County is not like that; actually, in the start, it was just a barren territory without any special units or high knights."
Genuine admiration appeared on her face as she continued.
"But then Magnus Duvall was born."
"In the start he was nothing, but later he started showing power related to the storm."
She stops for a moment as she is lost in thought because even in the palace she heard news about him.
"Some holy priests came, and they found out that he was born with an origin skill that was highly compatible with Storm."
"Many people become excited after hearing this news and come to recruit him because those who are born with Origin skills are all talented people who always make a name for themselves.
"Even on a lower scale!"
"And they are also way better than average people, as they can progress in realm cultivation faster with low resources."
She paused after this and gave me a look, which I understand.
She is thinking about when I was told I was talentless.
I instantly remember the time when Saintness declared the answer, when I got ridiculed by everyone and was finally forced to marry the five princesses.
After sorting my thoughts, I asked the system if this is all true or not.

[Yes, Luke, only in a natural way do those who get origin skills become talented, but most people of this world have origin inside them it is just some awakened while some not, even with that they can cultivate.]
The system paused to let me digest this info and then added another line.
[As you are given the Origin skill by me and you are not even from this world, that’s why you can’t cultivate at all unless heavy resources are invested.]
I nodded, as I finally understood the reason for my being talentless and why everyone gives me that look.
"What about those previous heroes?" Still, this question suddenly comes into my mind, so they were also talentless?
[No, Luke, whenever a hero was summoned, he or she got the blessing of the Valtharion.]
[Because of that, they become even more talented like a prodigy born in a millennium.]
I got stunned after hearing, "Then why didn’t I get the blessing?"
Sytem saw the confused look, but his voice also came out confused.
[I don’t know the exact reason, but it’s seems you are disconnected by the world itself.]
The system paused after saying this and then added.
[It seems like someone has done something when you were summoned.]
The system finally dropped the bombshell.
"I was targeted, but why? By whom?"
"Are you ok?"
Aurielle’s voice suddenly brings me out of my thoughts, and I shake my head because thinking about those things is now useless.
I can see she is worried and thinking that her word hurts me.
Because climbing each stage is going to be climbing a bigger mountain than before, and no one is stupid enough to waste resources on the hero who doesn’t have much potential.
"So, she is thinking that I am worried about how much I can raise my realm."
"I am fine, honey."
I smiled and said to her, and she nodded with relief and then continued from where she left off.
Nyx and Myrkhal also listen with curiosity, as both of them don’t know anything about this world at all.
"But Magnus said no to everyone and kept practicing on his own, and this very thing makes many nobles or people with power dissatisfied."
"And the result was annihilation..., because one day when he was practicing and his family was watching him happily, their territory got attacked by powerful bandits."
"Lord Duvall instantly found something was wrong, so he instantly gathered the forces and sent the pigeons to ask for help."
"Magnus also heard this, but he didn’t get afraid; instead, he also attacked them and defended his territory, but sadly he was alone, as most soldiers in his territory were iron and bronze knights."

"The battle lasts for a few hours, and no one comes to help him. All those who saw him have potential, but he doesn’t want to become theirs, so they turn their eyes away and let him understand the outcome of his arrogance."
"Bloodied and wounded, he saw everyone die: his father, his mother, and even his brother."

"And finally he got tired and broke down; he slumped to the ground with all hope lost because he lost everything and he has nothing anymore, so all he does is look at the sky and wait for his inevitable death."
Aurielle paused as tears formed in her eyes.
I didn’t say anything; I just listened, as did Margaret, even though she had heard this story before, but whenever she heard this, she also got teary-eyed.
Finally, after a moment as she got calm, she continued.
"Then a miracle occurred. First came a single drop, then countless others followed. Within moments, the heavens opened, and a raging storm descended upon the land, destroying everything in its path."
"Houses were ripped apart and reduced to debris. As for the bandits, they were swept away by the storm’s fury and hurled through the air like ragdolls, crashing to the ground with heavy injuries."

"Even after all this, the storm did not calm. Instead, the winds grew fiercer, howling across the land as lightning crackled through the heavens with such terrifying force that even the surrounding regions could hear it clearly. It was as if the heavens themselves were enraged and the end of the world had arrived."
"But one figure remained safe, as though the heavens themselves were protecting him. Yet he still lay on the ground, staring up at the sky with all hope lost."
She paused for a moment and then said it.
"Soon the holy priest of the storm god comes to him and tells him that he is chosen as an apostle for the storm god."
"When this news spread, everyone got jealous, and those who attacked him got terrified."
"But sadly they can’t do anything as the Storm Temple knights themselves descend for him."
"He left the human territory under the gaze of everyone; even the human emperor couldn’t stopped them or he will face the wraith of a god."
"He reached the Storm Temple, situated in the middle of the sea upon a vast island whose size rivaled that of an entire continent."
"There he trained himself and found out the real potential that his original skill holds."
She stopped as her mouth got dry, upon which Margaret gave her a water pouch.
Gulp.
As she satisfied her thirst, she started from where she left off.
"Everyone forgot that a prodigy, Magnus Duvall exists, because for 10 years no one heard about him."
"But—"
"Then the war with demons erupted suddenly; many nations fell because they got too relaxed."
"It was then that he rose, turning the tide of fate itself. By saving hundreds of sea territories, he earned the gratitude of countless people and was honored as a hero across the seas."
Aurielle again paused as she gave me a look; I just smiled at this.
She nodded and then continued.

"After saving so much sea territory, even the demon got afraid because the causality is so high in the area where he was, so the demon retreated as they faced heavy resistance from the sea king as well."
"Then he heard the news that many human nations have already fallen along with his territory as well."
"Magnus got so angry that he finally left the Storm temple and said goodbye to the people he had made friends with over the years and returned to his motherland."
"Even though Magnus wants revenge, he also knows that those innocent shouldn’t suffer, so he charges alone and kills demons like ants."
"After fighting for months he took back his territory from the demons hands along with several territories of his enemies also."

"The demons also stopped attacking his territory because of the heavy losses they had suffered. And finally, after years of war, when the Holy Church of Light and the Emperor’s forces descended upon the battlefield, the demons were forced to retreat completely back to their own lands."
Aurielle paused for a breath and, after a few moments, finally said the last part.
"The human emperor got impressed by Magnus’s bravery and made him a count while also presenting those territories to him."

"His remaining enemies, who had survived the demonic invasion, were filled with anger. Yet they could only swallow their resentment, for they knew that none of them could challenge him anymore. He had grown far too powerful for them to oppose."
Aurielle looked toward me and said it.
"That’s how the original Duvall territory had become Stormveil County."
"That’s amazing!"
This exclamation left my mouth after hearing his legendary story, and I genuinely started admiring this person because his story really looks like some fairy tale.
Aurielle smiled and leaned against my shoulder as she muttered in a low voice.
"For me, you are the one who is amazing."
I got stunned for a moment, but seeing her talking like that makes me want to love her.
So without thinking, my hand reached her bosom, and I felt those soft mounds.
Slap.
But suddenly, Aurielle slapped my hand away. I blinked in confusion, but then I noticed Margaret watching from the side with a red face. Only then did I realize why Aurielle had slapped my hand away.
"But I want to."
I said in a low voice, causing Aurielle’s face to turn red. Then, without warning, she leaned closer, kissed my cheek, and whispered into my ear.
"Wait for Stormveil County; there I will not stop you."
My eyes lit up on this, as I heard her seductive voice, but I controlled myself.
Then both of us lean toward each other and fall asleep, as the destination is still half a day away.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Blackstone’s Reputation
paragraphs: Soon afternoon came, and the sun reached its peak.
"My lord, we have officially entered StormVeil County."
Slowly I opened my eyes as I heard Margaret’s voice from the side.
Then after opening my eyes fully, I noticed she was pointing to outside.
I nodded at her, but instead of looking outside, I first checked on Aurielle, as she was already awake and was now sitting by the window.
Then I got confused, as both Nyx and Myrkhal were now missing, but when I concentrated on the link we shared, I found the answer. I could feel that they were inside me, but sleeping.
On this a sigh of relief escaped my mouth; after that I got close to Aurielle’s seat and leaned alongside her while also looking outside.
There in the distance, large caravans along with many people were moving, and some type of beast that I had never seen before but looked like Bastion was carrying the load as they pulled the cart.

Even though we are still in a forest region, the roads connecting to the main territory seem to be well maintained, and any beast cry was also not coming towards this area, which shows that the lord takes good care of his territory.
Then I heard Aurielle’s melancholic voice.
"Ten years ago, we were also part of Stormveil County."
"But after my mother became the ruler of Blackstone Highlands, she removed herself from Stormveil County following that incident."
She paused for a moment as she remembered her mother’s bloodied body.
"Because when the blackstone got attacked, she asked for help from everyone. Sadly, not even Stormveil County helped us."

Her face became sad, and she told me the news they heard: that Count did order everyone to help us, but everyone gave excuses that they were also facing threats inside their territory, so they couldn’t send their forces outside.
Later, Count got angry, and he himself prepared to save us, but then a letter came to him from the palace, saying if he moved, then the fight would become big, and the empire couldn’t face this now.
As Aurielle finished saying all this, her face changed to anger and she shouted. "Cowards!"
Then her eyes become moist as she looks toward me while continuing in a loud voice.
"Don’t they know that the concubine of the human emperor is there?"
A tear finally dropped and was released from her eyes; I got sad seeing this and brought my hands to wipe that tear and hold her in a hug.
Margaret also listened from the side, and her eyes also got wet.
"They know, but still no help comes."
Aurielle’s sad voice come, but she finally calms down a little in my embrace.
"Fortunately, with the help of terrain and at the cost of soldiers sacrifice, we were able to defend the territory."
I felt her hands suddenly hold me tightly as she finished her sentence.
On this I felt bad for her and said to her in a loving voice, "I am here, honey."
Then I lightly patted her back, to which she nodded but didn’t separate from me.
As we traveled, I observed the surrounding trees were getting shorter and shorter, and in the distance, we could see some villages as well.
Finally, after traveling for two more hours, we reached the Count’s territory, as the fiftyf oot tall black stone wall, heavily reinforced, could be seen even from a great distance.
I got shocked after seeing this. Aurielle saw my shocked face from the side and started laughing.
That laugh embarrassed me a little, so I just coughed to hide my embarrassment, but my gaze still didn’t remove itself from the count territory huge wall.
"How long is this?" This thought comes into my mind, as I can’t see the edges from here at all.
As we got closer to the wall, we saw a long line of people queuing in front of the huge gate, which had many archers and ballistae mounted above it.

I focused and counted the numbers; it seemed like hundreds of archers. Then I found more than 100 soldiers fully armed were also stationed outside; they do the inspection of every good, and some even check the poster if there are any wanted people.
Because of this, many people got irritated, but they still obliged and removed their cloaks and masks if they were wearing any.
Then my gaze turns toward one side of the gate; there a person is sitting with a carefree expression.
He is fully armed and was not hiding his aura at all. "Even the silver knight is there?" I got shocked because he just seems to be a gatekeeper.
Upon seeing this, I asked Aurielle.
Aurielle heard my shocked voice and nodded before replying.
"Most territories do this to show off their power and to prevent some idiots from having some foolish thoughts."
After that, she leaned forward and knocked on the wall of the carriage; a moment later, a small wooden panel slid open, revealing the driver’s face.
"Follow the noble line.
"Yes, my lady."
The coach driver nodded, then turned their carriage toward the noble line, which was empty.
Soon, many people also noticed the small carriage, modestly decorated and have the symbol of a silver sword planted into a black mountain beneath a howling wolf.
We moved toward the noble line, along with twenty knights who were heavily armored and followed the carriage closely.
The gate guards also stopped as they saw a carriage moving toward the noble line, and then they observed the symbol and soon found out.
"Blackstone Highlands."
One guard muttered it, which was heard by a few people, and soon everyone found out as well.
"Why are they here?"
One adventurer asked the surrounding group, and they gave him an idiotic look.
"Don’t you know? That count’s youngest daughter’s birthday is going to be held soon."
His expression changed as he really didn’t know, and then someone added another line.
"It seems like even though Blackstone became poor, they are still noble, so that’s why maybe the count invited them."
One merchant from the Ashenford heard this, and his face became ugly because he heard the rumors that Master Roland and Darius Ashenford also disappeared in that Blackstone territory.
So with a sour face, he said.
"I don’t think they got any invitation."

The surrounding group’s eyes widened because talking badly about a noble often resulted in execution, but when they realized he was talking about the Blackstone Territory, they calmed down because those nobles didn’t have enough forces to defend themselves, so how could they uphold their honor as well?
Seeing everyone calm down, he continued.
"I heard that their territory is on the verge of collapse, and even the river water has been cut off."
"And all of this occurred because that exiled princess made her husband, that talentless hero, the new lord."
"What?" Everyone was shocked after hearing this, as the news of the new lord had not yet reached the common adventurers and merchants. Only nobles and some high-level merchants knew about it.

sentences.text: Soon afternoon came, and the sun reached its peak.
"My lord, we have officially entered StormVeil County."
Slowly I opened my eyes as I heard Margaret’s voice from the side.
Then after opening my eyes fully, I noticed she was pointing to outside.
I nodded at her, but instead of looking outside, I first checked on Aurielle, as she was already awake and was now sitting by the window.
Then I got confused, as both Nyx and Myrkhal were now missing, but when I concentrated on the link we shared, I found the answer.
I could feel that they were inside me, but sleeping.
On this a sigh of relief escaped my mouth; after that I got close to Aurielle’s seat and leaned alongside her while also looking outside.
There in the distance, large caravans along with many people were moving, and some type of beast that I had never seen before but looked like Bastion was carrying the load as they pulled the cart.

Even though we are still in a forest region, the roads connecting to the main territory seem to be well maintained, and any beast cry was also not coming towards this area, which shows that the lord takes good care of his territory.
Then I heard Aurielle’s melancholic voice.
"Ten years ago, we were also part of Stormveil County."
"But after my mother became the ruler of Blackstone Highlands, she removed herself from Stormveil County following that incident."
She paused for a moment as she remembered her mother’s bloodied body.
"Because when the blackstone got attacked, she asked for help from everyone.
Sadly, not even Stormveil County helped us."

Her face became sad, and she told me the news they heard: that Count did order everyone to help us, but everyone gave excuses that they were also facing threats inside their territory, so they couldn’t send their forces outside.
Later, Count got angry, and he himself prepared to save us, but then a letter came to him from the palace, saying if he moved, then the fight would become big, and the empire couldn’t face this now.
As Aurielle finished saying all this, her face changed to anger and she shouted.
"Cowards!"
Then her eyes become moist as she looks toward me while continuing in a loud voice.
"Don’t they know that the concubine of the human emperor is there?"
A tear finally dropped and was released from her eyes; I got sad seeing this and brought my hands to wipe that tear and hold her in a hug.
Margaret also listened from the side, and her eyes also got wet.
"They know, but still no help comes."
Aurielle’s sad voice come, but she finally calms down a little in my embrace.
"Fortunately, with the help of terrain and at the cost of soldiers sacrifice, we were able to defend the territory."
I felt her hands suddenly hold me tightly as she finished her sentence.
On this I felt bad for her and said to her in a loving voice, "I am here, honey."
Then I lightly patted her back, to which she nodded but didn’t separate from me.
As we traveled, I observed the surrounding trees were getting shorter and shorter, and in the distance, we could see some villages as well.
Finally, after traveling for two more hours, we reached the Count’s territory, as the fiftyf oot tall black stone wall, heavily reinforced, could be seen even from a great distance.
I got shocked after seeing this.
Aurielle saw my shocked face from the side and started laughing.
That laugh embarrassed me a little, so I just coughed to hide my embarrassment, but my gaze still didn’t remove itself from the count territory huge wall.
"How long is this?" This thought comes into my mind, as I can’t see the edges from here at all.
As we got closer to the wall, we saw a long line of people queuing in front of the huge gate, which had many archers and ballistae mounted above it.
I focused and counted the numbers; it seemed like hundreds of archers.
Then I found more than 100 soldiers fully armed were also stationed outside; they do the inspection of every good, and some even check the poster if there are any wanted people.
Because of this, many people got irritated, but they still obliged and removed their cloaks and masks if they were wearing any.
Then my gaze turns toward one side of the gate; there a person is sitting with a carefree expression.
He is fully armed and was not hiding his aura at all.
"Even the silver knight is there?" I got shocked because he just seems to be a gatekeeper.
Upon seeing this, I asked Aurielle.
Aurielle heard my shocked voice and nodded before replying.
"Most territories do this to show off their power and to prevent some idiots from having some foolish thoughts."
After that, she leaned forward and knocked on the wall of the carriage; a moment later, a small wooden panel slid open, revealing the driver’s face.
"Follow the noble line.
"Yes, my lady."
The coach driver nodded, then turned their carriage toward the noble line, which was empty.
Soon, many people also noticed the small carriage, modestly decorated and have the symbol of a silver sword planted into a black mountain beneath a howling wolf.
We moved toward the noble line, along with twenty knights who were heavily armored and followed the carriage closely.
The gate guards also stopped as they saw a carriage moving toward the noble line, and then they observed the symbol and soon found out.
"Blackstone Highlands."
One guard muttered it, which was heard by a few people, and soon everyone found out as well.
"Why are they here?"
One adventurer asked the surrounding group, and they gave him an idiotic look.
"Don’t you know?
That count’s youngest daughter’s birthday is going to be held soon."
His expression changed as he really didn’t know, and then someone added another line.
"It seems like even though Blackstone became poor, they are still noble, so that’s why maybe the count invited them."
One merchant from the Ashenford heard this, and his face became ugly because he heard the rumors that Master Roland and Darius Ashenford also disappeared in that Blackstone territory.
So with a sour face, he said.
"I don’t think they got any invitation."

The surrounding group’s eyes widened because talking badly about a noble often resulted in execution, but when they realized he was talking about the Blackstone Territory, they calmed down because those nobles didn’t have enough forces to defend themselves, so how could they uphold their honor as well?
Seeing everyone calm down, he continued.
"I heard that their territory is on the verge of collapse, and even the river water has been cut off."
"And all of this occurred because that exiled princess made her husband, that talentless hero, the new lord."
"What?" Everyone was shocked after hearing this, as the news of the new lord had not yet reached the common adventurers and merchants.
Only nobles and some high-level merchants knew about it.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Unions of Many Races
paragraphs: "What?" Everyone was shocked after hearing this, as the news of the new lord of BlackStone Highlands had not yet reached the common adventurers and merchants. Only nobles and some high level merchants knew about it.
"So maybe that’s why they come here, for begging money from the count’s family."
As he finally finished speaking, surrounding people started gossiping about this, and the guard at the door also heard this along with Silver Knight.
Soon, some guards faces twisted in disgust because they also disliked it when someone ruined their own land by making just anyone a lord and then came here to beg money from their lord.

"Here," the guard said. Even though they didn’t show much respect, they also didn’t dare be disrespectful, because a noble was still of a higher rank than them, and they had to maintain the proper etiquette befitting their lord.
But the silver knight watched this with curiosity, because other people can’t feel it.

But he was a Vertren Peak Silver Knight who had seen and trained so many knights that he could tell their rank from even a slight trace of their aura, so he could clearly sense that those twenty fully armored knights were at the Bronze Rank, and some had even made notable progress.
"Interesting," he muttered softly, so quietly that even the attendant beside him didn’t hear it.

"Is this new lord really useless and talentless?" This thought soon came to his mind, and a small smile appeared on his face, but then he shook his head and lay back in the chair to finish his afternoon nap.
In the carriage, everyone heard the public gossiping, and the Blackstone legion knights faces also changed, as Kai was even thinking of using his owl screech to make their ears bleed.
"No need." But then they heard their master’s calm voice, on which everyone settled down, at least that’s what it seemed but their faces were still angry inside their armor.
"Let them enter."
As the guard’s voice rang out, a small gate, which was only opened for nobles, slowly swung open beside the huge black-silver color gate.
"Enter"
Soon my knights, along with carriage, entered the gate, and with a huge bang, the gate behind us closed completely.
"Wow." The moment I entered the territory, I was amazed, even though it’s not comparable to the modern world.
but-
I saw people moving around in different stylish dresses, as many different races could be seen among them.
"Elves, dark elves, people with fins, giants, dwarves, and even goblins," I muttered, naming all those that I could identify.
Then I asked Aurielle about this; she also stopped observing and answered my question.
"Because the Count’s celebration is often open to everyone and many races also come to enjoy it."
"Those are the only words," Aurielle said.

Even though I didn’t get the full answer, I still nodded and continued observing the surroundings while the whole group slowly moved toward the inn area, as we could only enter the Count’s estate once the celebration began.
"Of course, if you are a big noble and their relative, then you can enter before it."
This thought comes into my mind as I remember the crowd’s gossip at the gate.
"They sure do have huge buildings," because in the distance, I saw many buildings that are in the shape of pagoda and are very tall.
Then I read the names on the large board hanging above them.
"Alchemist union, merchant trade union, adventurer guild, and blacksmith union."
Different large buildings have different names. "But why are all of them unions?"
Aurielle also noticed my confused expression, and then she told me that all of these associations are driven by profit.
"So, they have to sell their things on different races land as well; that’s why they make the union, to prevent any forces from suppressing them on the new land."
She explained more, as when they formed this, they faced big backlash and even assassinations.
"But then, they give fixed seats to each race, which finally calms down the conflict, and this allows them to do business everywhere."

I nodded at her words, because if members of their race were also present in those unions, then they could conduct business properly within their own lands or even in foreign territories, and their race would not be suppressed, which would give them a form of security.
Finally, after traveling for half an hour, we reached an inn, which was mostly empty.
"All those good inns are already booked," I muttered with a sigh. Well, I can’t say I am rich, but I definitely have those 5000 silver coins.
Then I looked at the inn, which was a mixture of wood and stone and stood three stories tall.
And from the gate, we could see that it had a carriage area and a stable section, which was really well maintained.
"Welcome, Sir."
As we entered the gate, I saw a beautiful cat girl in a maid dress, welcoming us with a beaming smile.
"Hello."
I habitually greeted her back with a smile on my face.
"Cough...cough..."
Aurielle suddenly coughed and came in front, and then she asked her about the room for everyone and also the food issue.
"Sure, ma’am." With that, she arranged a seat for all of us, as I can see many seats are empty.
Only the owner, a middle-aged man, was wiping the counter with a cloth, even though it didn’t seem dirty.
Then they served us hot meals, which were bread and soup.
Sadly, this is all they can provide, and if we want to eat something delicious, then we have to go to a restaurant.
I didn’t say anything, just enjoyed eating, while everyone followed suit.
After a few minutes the cat girl returned and gave us the keys to the third floor, along with the rooms keys.
I nodded and paid her the 100 silver coins for the one day, which is really costly, but it’s what I can do.
After finishing our meal. I left the inn with Aurielle, as we planned to tour the city and also enjoy our little date together.
"All of you here are the 1000 silver coins; go ahead and enjoy, just make sure to return before nightfall."
I gave the money to Kai, and he smiled at this; then he left along with every knight in normal shirts and pants, as they had already stored their armor inside the room.
"Margaret- "Before I can say anything to Margaret," she shook her head and said.
"My lord, I would want to rest here and also keep guarding the armors."
Aurielle heard her, but she insisted that she should also enjoy and tour the city, but Margaret didn’t agree. In the end, I nodded and left with Aurielle.
We first reached the place that has the most gathered crowd.
"Those snake women are so hot that whenever I see their dance, I can’t control myself."
"Heh...you think this is a real snake dance?"
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 49: A Tale of Love and Ruin
paragraphs: "Those snake women are so hot that whenever I see their dance, I can’t control myself."
"Heh...you think this is a real snake dance?"
After we arrived at the place, we heard people talking about snake women dances, which often mesmerize men.
"Hmm. It looks interesting," I said, but the next moment I heard Aurielle’s cold voice.
"What’s so interesting about this?"
A sweat formed on my head, and I turned toward her, who is now looking at me like I have cheated on her again.
"Honey, it’s not like that." I calm her down barely and then continue. "Look, so many people of different races are here to watch them, so maybe their dances are really great."
As I finished my sentence, I ran away from her toward the token counter side.
"Ugh, why does she often look at me like I have slept with other women?"
"Well, I did though, with Selene, but she is also my wife."
After finishing my inner monologue, I queued for a token, and then I heard the same conversation again because those two people also queued in the front.
"Wait? What real snake woman dance?"
One middle aged man asked with a confused expression, as he had watched their dance before, and he found all that to his liking.
The other person is a young man with blonde hair, like some rich brat, because he is wearing luxurious clothes.
He smirked then continued.
"Even though you can’t see a real snake woman dance in your life, I will still enlighten you."
The middle aged man got offended but still calmed down after hearing his next word because he really wanted to know about the real snake-woman dance.
"Yeah, I also want to hear it."
Suddenly, with curiosity, I muttered my thoughts outside.
Both persons turned back to look at me, but after seeing my curious expression, the young man just shrugged and told both of us.
"So listen."
He set the mood first, then said in a low voice.
"Many years ago I traveled to the beast empire with my father, who is a very rich merchant."
He paused and looked at both of our expressions. Finding us listening focusedly, he nodded and continued.
"In the beast empire, we finally reach the snake kingdom, whose people are half human and half snake."
"In that kingdom, only after reaching certain strength can one freely transform into human form or snake form.
He took a breath and, after a moment, continued.
"Only noble or high bloodlines can transform into human form or half snake form from their birth."
"But—"
He took a long pause, during which both that middle aged man and I urged him to continue and told him fast.
He smiled and said. "I heard a tale where only the royal bloodline knows the real snake dance, which they got bestowed by their snake god."
He looked at our eyes, and with a wide grin, he continued.
"But along with this dance come a curse and a blessing."
"That only female royal blood can do this dance."
He stopped, as he was lost in thought of those images he had seen in the black market.
"I have seen those images, and it was perfect."
Both of us give him a glare. What are you talking about, buddy? Tell us as well.
He also noticed our expression, and then with a smile he continued.
"The royal princess, when she finds her soulmate, has to perform that snake woman dance naked in front of him."
"If not, then her strength will be stuck forever in the same realm."
"What?" both of us exclaimed, and I took a handful of peanuts before stuffing them into my mouth, which the middle aged man had suddenly offered me.
The young man nodded and spoke.
"But here is the twist: she has to do this in her half snake and half human form.
"Oh..." I took another peanut, and as the story was getting interesting, the middle aged man also nodded.
"So, if the man belongs to the same race, then it will be fine, but—"
"But what?!" both of us urged him as the story finally reached its peak.
He smiled and came close to our ear before saying it.
"But if the man belongs to another race and she performs her dance, will he be able to like her?"
"Liking a snake?"
Both of us paused. He is right, "but the upper part still looks good."
The middle aged man said, to which I nodded absentmindedly.
The young man also smiled and told us the remaining story.
"Yes, but the man has to accept her love by mating with her."
"The hell? Meaning the rod is going to enter the snake hole?"
My eyes twitched when another bearded person suddenly joined our small group and said this while eating the peanuts from the middle aged man’s pouch.
All three of us give him an annoying look. "Do you really have to say the last part?"
The young man said, with a displeased face, but he still continued not minding that a fourth person came.
"If they did, then the snake princess would be able to transform into both forms normally and even gain power, and her talent with Origin skills would also improve by a great margin."
"Damn, that’s crazy!!!" All three of us exclaimed as our mouths completely filled with peanuts, and we looked like three squirrels with full cheeks, listening to something serious.
The young man also nodded but then sighed.
"It’s not that easy."
"First, not every royal princess is able to find her soulmate in her lifetime, and second, the person has to accept her as well."
All three of us express ourselves strangely: "What do you mean? Have to accept her as well?" Who is going to refuse this offer?"
The young man shook his head and told them.
"Well, someone did; it was one of the previous summoned heroes, and he is the one who rejected her and spread all this information because he didn’t like her lower snake body."
"What???"
All of us paused at this shocking information, then asked him what happened aftet that?.
He sighed and said. "Well, Princess Heart was already broken, and when she heard that, he also spread all the information along with the sketches of her naked dance."
"With this, she became so depressed that—"
He paused, as he also felt sad. "She committed suicide."
All three of us fell silent, as it was too much to take in; first he rejected her, then he went as far as to humiliate her by spreading her nude images.
[Chapter End]
